tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed phyag rgya zil gnon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ches zab cing gsang ba snying khrag lta bu bzhugs so//

'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed phyag rgya zil gnon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog ya mā rir phyag 'tshal lo// 'di nyid kyi dbang thob cing dka' thub dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i sngags pas rdzogs pa'i rim pa nyams su blang ba la gnyis/ thun mong dang*| thun mong ma yin pa gnyis so// dang po thun mong ba ni/ rdzogs rim dbang bzhi'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba logs su bshad pa ltar sngon du nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim snying khrag lta bu ches shin tu zab pa rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid nyams su blang ba la bzhi/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes/ gnad dus so// dang po sngon 'gro la gsum/ spyi dang*/ bye brag /khyad par ro// dang po spyi'i sngon 'gro la bzhi/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ mi rtag cing 'chi ba/ rgyu 'bras la yid ches/ 'khor ba'i nyes pa bsam pa rnams ni lam gzhan ltar nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa bye brag gi sngon 'gro la bzhi/ tshogs zhing spyan drang ba/ bzhugs su gsol ba/ bdun rnam dag /sdom pa gzung ba'o// dang po tshogs zhing spyan drang ba ni/ bde ba'i stan la lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan par/ gter gzhung nas 'byung ba 'di nyid 'don sgom sbrags te/ na mo bla ma 'jam dpal tshe yi bdag /dus 'di nas bzung ye shes sems dpa'i sku// ma thob bar du phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad sgrol bar shog /ces gsum gyis skyabs 'gro bya/ bdag nyid tshe bdag nag po yi// thugs ka'i dwangs ma 'od lnga las// 'od zer grangs med phyogs bcur 'phros// dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro dam can gshin rje'i tshogs// dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren gshegs// zhes spyan drangs/ gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ e nang drag po'i gnas 'di ru// gshin rje chu glang gdan steng du// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad ni// rngam brjid stabs kyis bzhugs su gsol// zhes bzhugs par bsam/

gsum pa bdun rnam dag ni/ ha ha bzhad pa'i nyams dang ldan// hi ni gad mo 'jigs par mdzad// mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud| |sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// srid pa gsum na sdug pa dang*// gtum chen ma rungs pa dag gi| |sha khrag rus pa nang khrol mkhris// phyi nang mchod pas mchod par bgyi// rang rig ye shes chos kyi sku// thig le 'od gsal 'gyur med kyang*// ma rtogs log rtog blor ma ldan// ye shes lha la mthol lo bshags// khams gsum 'khor ba dag mdzad ma// theg pa gsum gyi chos tshul gyis// dge ba mdzad pa thams cad la// bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// 'gro ba gang 'dul dam pa'i chos// sna tshogs ji ltar 'dul gyur pa// rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che// pad+ma ral gri bskor du gsol// yang dag chos kyi dbyings nyid du// 'od gsal bar ni bzhugs gyur pa// 'gro la brtse ba'i cho 'phrul gyis// mya ngan mi 'da' snang bzhugs gsol// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis// 'jig rten 'dir yang sangs rgyas 'gyur// 'gro la phan pa'i chos kyang ston// thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes lan gsum/

bzhi pa sdom pa gzung ba ni/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa// sras bcas rgyal ba 'khor bcas dang*// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir// dus gsum mgon pos gang mdzad pa'i// don de bdag gis gzung bar bgyi// dri ma bral ba'i tshul khrims dang*| |chos rnams yongs bsdu dge ba dang*// sems can don byed rnam pa gsum// bdag gis yongs su gzung bar bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// de bzhin ma grol ba rnams dgrol// dbyugs la phyin rnams dbyugs dbyung zhing*// thams cad mya ngan 'das la 'god// 'jam dpal sku yi dam tshig tu// dkon mchog gsum gzung mi btang ngo*// 'jam dpal gsung gi dam tshig tu// theg pa gsum po ma nyams gzung*// 'jam dpal thugs kyi dam tshig tu// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya gzung*// 'jam dpal yon tan dam tshig tu// dus drug sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin// 'jam dpal phrin las dam tshig tu// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bya// 'jam dpal thams cad 'dus pa yi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// sdom pa kun dang yang dag ldan// rgyud kun yongs su gzung bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum/ gsum pa khyad par kyi sngon 'gro la gsum/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol gdab/ dbang blang ba'o// dang po maṇ+ḍal dbul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ rin chen du mas brgyan pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di// bla ma 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes shing mnyes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bul/ dbang rgyas pa blang na/ skabs 'dir bdag 'jug rgyun 'khyer logs su yod pa'i skabs kyi dga' chen khyod bdag gis gsol ba btab pa nas dbang bzhi'i bar rdzogs par blangs/ bsdu na/ gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mthing nag e las drag po'i gzhal yas su// gshin rje chu glang brdzis pa'i gdan steng du// 'jam dpal ya mān+ta ka gshin rje'i gshed// gshed po khro bo dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

gsum pa dbang blang ba ni/ tshogs zhing gtso bo'i thugs ka nas oṃ dkar| āḥdamar/ hūm̐ mthing rim gyis spros pa bdag gi dpral mgrin snying gar thim par bsam zhing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed sku dang ldan// deng bdag sangs rgyas sku 'dzin pa// sku yi rdo rje oṃ yang sbyin// kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ 'od kyis lus gang bum dbang thob// dpal ldan rdo rje'i gsung 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed gsung dang ldan// deng bdag sangs rgyas gsung 'dzin pa// gsung gi rdo rje āḥyang sbyin// wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ 'od kyis gang bas gsang dbang thob/ */dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed thugs dang ldan// deng bdag sangs rgyas thugs 'dzin pa// thugs kyi rdo rje hūm̐ du mdzod// tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ 'od kyis gang bas thugs dbang thob/ gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs shing e ka he dun sogs bsgrags pas 'joms byed gshin rje'i tshogs thams cad bsdus/ a+yai ring gi rnam par gyur/ char ltar bab pa rang gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du thim pas rang lus 'od ser pos gang*/ de thams cad 'ubs kyis snying ga'i dwangs ma dang 'dres par bsam zhing*/ bla ma bcom ldan gshin rje'i dgra// gsod byed ma dang mnyam sbyar nas// bde ba'i sgra chen rab tu bsgrags// a+yai ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ stong gsum sgra yis gang ba nas// 'joms byed 'bar ba gshin rje'i srog /ma lus 'od kyis phrogs nas ni// gsang sngags a+yai ring char du bab// ba spu'i bu ga kun tu zhugs// btso ma gser 'dra'i 'od kyis gang*// snying ga'i dwangs ma'i dbus su zhugs// 'khor 'das gnyis med ye shes sems// stong gsal zung 'jug dbang bzhi thob// bsdu ba ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: bla ma 'jam dpal lha tshogs kun// ma lus bdag gi snying gar bstim// rno la ngar gyis rab btags nas// 'chi bdag sde dpung bdud las rgyal// zhes dmigs med kyi ngang du ci gnas bzhag

/mthar/ sems can ma lus bde ldan zhing*// sdug bsngal srid pa'i mtha' bral nas// bde chen ye shes thob gyur cig /khyab bdag chen po la gnas shog /ces smon lam gdab bo// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rtsa ba dang*/ yan lag go// dang po rtsa ba rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor la bzhi/ bum dbang gi nyams len gong bu dbyibs sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ gsang dbang gi nyams len srog rtsol 'bar 'dzag gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ sher dbang gi nyams len phyag rgya rnam gnyis thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ tshig dbang gi nyams len bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnams so// dang po bum dbang gi nyams len gong bu'i dbyibs sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gsum/ gsal snang 'don pa/ rim pa bzhi la bslab pa/ gnad bzhis gzir ba'o// dang po gsal snang 'don pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par bya ba dang*/ zhes pa nas/ mi tshugs pa'i mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don dkyus ltar gsal snang thon nges par bsgom par bya'o// de rjes/ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// ces pa nas| sgrub na lang tsho nga dang mnyam// zhes pa'i bar gyis nga rgyal brtan nas/ slar yang*/ khams gsum ma lus gzhal yas chen por blta// zhes pa nas/ gzung 'dzin rnam dag mtshan ma'i yul las 'das// zhes pa'i bar gyis rnam dag dran pa dang 'khyer so gsum la bslab bo// gnyis pa rim pa bzhi la bslab pa ni/ rang zil gnon gyi sku snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur gsal ba'i sku las rang 'dra'i sku dpag tu med pa spros pas stong khams gang*/ snang ba thams cad ya mā ra'i skur gyur/ de las kyang lha spros pas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang ba la sems gtad/ slar de thams cad 'od zer du bsdus thig le yungs 'bru tsam pa de la rten dang brten pa thams cad ma 'dres pa rdzogs pa zhig

/mchan/ du bsam/ slar de las lha chung mang po spros/ 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang 'gro ba thams cad lhar gyur/ de dag thams cad kyang rang sems rol pa chen po las gzhan du mi lta zhing*/ slar rang la bsdu ba ni rim pa dang po'o// yang stong gsum lhas gang ba de dag thams cad rang gtso bor gsal ba la zhal phyogs pa thams cad kyang thugs mi g.yo bar ting 'dzin 'ba' zhig la gnas par bsam zhing*/ rang yang rtog med du mnyam par 'jog pa ni rim pa gnyis pa'o// yang stong gsum gang ba'i lha de dag thams cad zla ba gcig shar ba chu snod thams cad du snang ba ltar lha de dag thams cad gtso bo'i gzugs brnyan gyi gsal mdangs gzhan du shar ba lta bu las rgyud tha dad so sor dbye ba med pa/ de dag thams cad kyang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa/ 'ja' tshon ltar gsal 'tsher lhun brjid du bsgom pa ni rim pa gsum pa'o// yang rang lhar gsal ba dang stong gsum lhas gang ba de dag thams cad ni nam mkha'i mtha' ltar tshad bzung med pa/ sku gsung thugs sgrib g.yogs bral ba gsal zhing dri ma med pa/ rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa ni rim pa bzhi pa'o// gsum pa gnad bzhis gzir ba ni/ phyi rol gyi rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lhar gsal ba thams cad rang la skad cig gis bsdus nas lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun la sgrim pa lus gnad/ sna bug gnyis nas rlung ro lan gsum 'bud pa ngag gi gnad/ sems dus gsum gyi rtog pas ma bslad par so ma stong gsal du gnas pa yid kyi gnad/ rang lhar gsal ba'i snying gar dwangs ma 'od kyi gong bu don gyi skur gnas shing*/ mig nam mkha'i gnas su 'byed 'dzum g.yo 'gul med par gtad la nyin mtshan bar ma chad du mnyam par 'jog pa ni mig gi gnad do// de ltar gnad bzhis gzir te bsgoms pas mngon shes lnga dang ye shes dbyings kyi rtags snang sna tshogs pa 'char zhing*/

'khor 'das thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa zung 'jug don gyi sgyu ma sprul pa'i skur grol ba ni bum dbang gi nyams len mthar thug pa snying khrag lta bu ste sku yi zil gnon phyag rgya'i yang tig go// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa gsang dbang gi nyams len srog rtsol 'bar 'dzag gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la lnga/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor/ gtum mo sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin/ gzhi gtan la dbab pa| de nyid nyams su blang ba/ snang ba bzhi nyams su blang ba'o// dang po phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi chos bdun dang ldan pas/ rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i khog pa'i nang spyi bo nas gsang gnas bar du rtsa dbu ma phyi sngo nang dmar mda' snyug 'bring po tsam gsal ba'i snying thad dbu ma'i nang du dwangs ma 'od kyi thig le shin tu phra ba lcags rdul las kyang chung ba/ rang lus lha dang*/ nang gi dbu ma thig le dang bcas pa nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'bar zhing sgyu ma lta bur gsal la rang bzhin med par bsam zhing*/ snying ga'i thig le la sems ma yeng bar rtse gcig tu gtad la sna bug gi rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la 'brel rang babs su 'khrul 'khor bskor ba la 'bad do// des ni nyi zla'i 'od la sogs pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor gyi rtag snang rnams 'byung ngo*| |gnyis pa gtum mo sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ lus gnad me thab drug bcing dang ldan pas rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i khong pa'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma sngar ltar dang*/ de yi g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis yas sne sna bug dang*/ mas sne lte 'og sor bzhi nas dbu ma'i nang du tshud pa rtsa gsum las gyes pa spyi bor dam tshig gi phyag rgya bde chen 'khor lo smin mtshams kyi thad nang du rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par phyag rgya chen po longs spyod 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/

snying gar chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po/ lte bar las kyi phyag rgya sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar a ka tsa ṭa ta pa sha ya dang 'og tu k+ṣaḥ spyi bor rtsa 'dab so gnyis la a ā nas aṃ aḥ'i bar dbyangs bcu drug pa phrag gnyis pa de'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug la dbyangs bcu drug phrag gcig /snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad la phyogs bzhir buṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab kyi 'dab ma re bzhi la dbyangs bcu drug gsal byed so bzhi'i mthar/ ra la ny+pa ny+pha ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha da dha ya la rnams so// rtsa gsum 'dus nang ro rkyang gi steng du raṃ yig dmar po spyi bor haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan rnams gsal gdab/ sna bug nas phyir rlung drag cing thung ba'i rtsub rlung bus/ nang du 'jug pa na dal zhing ring ba'i 'jam rlung rngub la lte bar bkang zhing brdeg /'og rlung yar 'then pas raṃ las me cher 'bar spyi bo'i haṃ ma gtogs pa'i yi ge rnams bsregs/ me lce haṃ la reg pas haṃ las bdud rtsi bab pas yi ge rnams slar gsos rim pa bzhin 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa gsal zhing rlung gzung*/ de'i tshe drod kyi 'khrul 'khor gcig ni/ pho ba bskor zhing stod smad du sdig pa dang 'bul 'then 'bebs bya ste rtsub shing gi 'khrul 'khor bya'o// thig le'i 'khrul 'khor drug ni/ be con rdo rje bya ba'ang zer/ gtun shing*/ ral gri/ rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ sdigs mdzub ste 'khrul 'khor drug po ni 'og sgo'i rtsa sbyong ba'i rtsa'i 'khrul 'khor drug po skabs 'dir bya ste/ de rnams ni lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ro// steng rlung sdigs pas gzugs med khams dag /'og rlung bsdams pas 'dod khams sgrol/ kha sbyar bar rlung bskor bas gzugs khams zad do// de ltar 'bad/

yang rlung gtong ba'i tshe/ 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ dbyung ba hūm̐ dang*/ a+yai ring dang a+ye thung gi rang mdangs su bzla/ des ni du ba/ smig rgyu/ me khyer/ mar me/ mkha' snang*/ skra shad de rtags snang drug dang*/ chos thams cad nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bu snang la rang bzhin med par nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro// de dag ni gsung gi zil gnon phyag rgya'i yang tig go| |sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa gzhi gtan la dbab pa ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas/ rang sems chos sku brjod dang bral ba/ de'i rang rtsal snying thad dbu ma'i nang du thig le yungs 'bru lta bu/ de'ang nang gi 'byung ba sa'i rang bzhin sra ba/ chu'i rang bzhin gsher la snum pa/ me'i rang bzhin tsha zhing 'od 'bar ba/ rlung gi rang bzhin 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin snang zhing gsal la stong pa/ 'byung ba lnga 'dus mi shigs pa'i thig le de la sems gtad de/ sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa dang phral la rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas rang byung gi ye shes bcos min rgyud la 'char ro// bzhi pa de nyid lam du blang ba ni/ mi shigs byang chub sems kyi thig le sems dang dbyer med pa de nyid kyi rtsal snang rang gsal ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ kha dog sna tshogs su 'bar zhing phyogs ris med pa'i stong nyid la/ dbugs kyi dwangs ma rlangs pa tsam sems nyid thig le snang stong mnyam nyid ye shes/ drod kyi dwangs ma me long nyi 'od ltar 'phrad pa ltar rgya chad phyogs lhung med par gang bltas pa der snang ba sor rtog ye shes/ khrag gi dwangs ma lcog la'i mtshal lta bu sbyangs pa thig le yungs 'bru lta bu de sems dang dbyer med mtha' dbus bral ba bya grub ye shes/ de thams cad brjod bral chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang du 'ub chub pa chos dbyings ye shes/ yang rtsa'i dwangs ma dar dkar gyi skud pa lta bu rta rnga bcur bshags pa'i tshad tsam gnas pa phyi nang du rgyu ba'i rlung bcu dang bcas pa don yod grub pa yab yum/

lus drod lhun grub rang gsal ngo bo nyid du rang bzhin gyis grub pa snang mtha' yab yum/ khrag dang chu ser rin 'byung yab yum/ sha dang rus pa rnam snang yab yum/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang 'byung ba nam mkha' rdor sems yab yum| de thams cad rgyus ma bskyed/ dngos med ye shes kyi rang rtsal/ rang byung rang shar gnyen po med cing*/ rdzas ma grub/ skye 'bri med/ rang rtsal phyogs ris dang bral ba/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ thog mtha' med pa/ rang sems/ rang byung*/ rang rtsal/ dus gsum du 'gyur ba med pa/ 'gag pa med pa/ chos sku'i rang rtsal rang shar ba ye shes lnga/ de'i rtsal snang dwangs ma lnga/ de'i rtsal snang 'byung ba lnga/ rtsal rtsol thams cad kyang rang shar chos sku/ bde sdug thams cad rang shar chen po'i klong*/ 'du 'bral med pa dbyer med/ gsal sgrib spangs pa rang shar/ rang byung longs sku/ de thams cad rang rtsal yin par shes pas ngan song gsum rang sar dag /myang 'das rang bzhin gyis grub pas/ sangs rgyas logs na btsal mi dgos/ de yang ye gdod ma'i rang gi shes pa mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir ye shes thams cad rang byung rang shar bas gzung ba chos kyi bdag dang bral ba/ phyogs ris su ma chad pas 'dzin pa gang zag gi bdag dang bral ba/ gnyis med spros bral thogs rdug zag pa dang bral ba'i phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i sprul pa'i sku'o// de ltar lam du blang ba'i don bsgom pa ni/ snying ga'i thig le dang rang sems rgyu ba'i rlung rnams tha mi dad dbyer med brjod bral du nyams su blangs pas sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro// de ltar rlung sems thig le gsum dbyer med la sems gtad pa tsam gyis drod du 'bar/ gsal ba tsam gyis 'khor ba dag pa yin gyi/ tha snyad kyi chos kyis sangs rgyas pa dkon no// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: lnga pa snang bzhi nyams su blang ba la drug /lus kyi gnad/ ngag gi gnad/ yid kyi gnas/ sgo'i gnad/

yul gyi gnad/ rlung gi gnad do// dang po lus kyi gnad ni/ gnas yul kha dma' ba dang sgrub po lus tsha shas che zhing bying 'thib can gyis ni chos sku'i bzhugs stangs seng ge lta bu/ gtan bde ba la lus 'gying tshul rkang mthil dang 'phong sar phab/ pus mo g.yas g.yon du bskyed pa'i bar du lag pa gnyis gshib/ lag sor bskums pa'i nang sar phab/ ro stod dgye/ shugs 'jing pa la bskur/ mig nam mkhar gtad do// yang gnas mtho dman snyom pa dang*/ sgrub po lus tsha grang snyom pa dang*/ shes pa bying rgod ran pa dag gis ni longs sku'i bzhugs stangs glang chen lta bu kha sbub pus brang sbyar/ rkang sor phyir phul/ gru mo sar btsugs/ sor mos lkog ma brten/ 'jing pa cung zad gyen la bteg /mig bar snang la gtad do// yang gnas mtho ba dang sgrub po lus grang shas che zhing shes pa rgod pa dag gis ni sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs drang srong tsog pu rkang pa'i long bu gnyis gshib/ tsog pu pus brang sbyar/ pus brang bar du lag pa bsnol/ lus drang por bsrang*/ 'jing pa yid tsam dgye/ mig gnyis sna rtse'i nam mkha' la gtad do// gnyis pa ngag gi gnad ni/ long gtam smra ba bcad/ skabs skabs su chos spyod rnams sgra gsal bar brjod/ gzhan dang ngag mi bsre/ dgos gal che na lag gis brda bya/ lkugs pa lta bur gnas so// gsum pa yid kyi gnad ni/ dus gsum gyi rnam rtog mtshan ma 'gyu dran thams cad rbad kyis bcad la sems so ma bcos min gyi ngang du bzhag go// bzhi pa sgo yi gnad ni/ mig chos sku'i bzhugs stangs la gyen du cung zad ldog pa/ longs sku la bar snang gi mkhar mig zur gyi hrig po/ sprul sku la mig sna rtse yi thad kyi nam mkha' la zim bur blta'o// lnga pa yul gyi gnad ni/ sprin bral gyi nam mkha' la g.ya' dag pa dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ mar me'i 'od rnams so// drug pa rlung gi gnad shin tu dal ba la phyir an tsam dor/

de'i ngang la blta'o// de ltar gnad drug dang ldan pas nyams su blang ba ni/ snying gi nang du rang rig ngo bo'i sku/ rang bzhin 'od/ thugs rje'i mtshan ma zhal phyag gi rnam pa dang bcas te/ gsal dwangs rang stong du lham mer bzhugs pa ste/ snying la dkar 'chag rtsa'i sgron ma ba men gyi rwa lta bu dang dar dkar gyi skud pa tsam mig tu zug pa de'i nang nas thon/ phyi nam mkha'i dbyings su 'char ro// de ltar bsgoms pas mig mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba 'ja' 'am rma bya'i mdongs lta bu zhig 'char/ de'i nang du thig le stong pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba chu nang du rdo bor ba'i ri mo lta bu rim pa du ma yod pa yungs 'bru'am sran ma'i kha tsam 'char/ de'i nang du rig pa rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud ces bya ba rta rnga la mu tig brgyus pa lta bu'am/ lcags thag brkyang pa lta bu'i dra ba dra phyed rlung gis bskyod pa lta bu gnyis 'brel dang*/ sum 'brel dang*/ dkar khro khro ba 'char ste/ de ni rang mdangs rig pa'i ngo bo thig le nyag gcig mthong ba ste chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba zhes bya'o// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yang gong ltar 'bad de bsgoms pas dbyings rig res gsal res mi gsal ba las nam mkha'i dbyings su yer gyis thon te mig snga nas 'bral ba med par/ thig le sran ma tsam las/ 'od lnga yang phra ba dang*/ rags pa dang*/ gsal ba dang*/ 'tsher ba dang*/ lhun sdug pa dang*/ thig le dang*/ thig phran/ za 'og gi gur khyim lta bu dang*/ nya mig dang*/ rma bya'i mdongs dang*/ lcags tshags dang*/ khrol ma lta bu dang*/ gyen sgreng dang*/ rtsibs shar dang*/ dpal be'u dang*/ rin po che 'bar ba lta bu la sogs pas lung pa khengs pa tsam la thig le yang cher rgyas par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang 'od yul khams khengs pa dang*/ stong gsum khengs pa dang*/ thig le re re'i nang du thig le lnga tshom dang*/ bcu tshom dang*/ 'bar ba lta bu dang*/

mched pa lta bu dang*/ 'od gyu gyu bol snum la 'dril ba'i thig le dang thig phran 'char/ de thams cad mi 'gyur bar sdod cing de las snang ba thams cad longs skur 'char te/ dbyings rig mi 'bral ba'i sku rkyang pa dang*/ phyed sku dang*/ sku lnga tshom sogs blta bas chog mi shes pa rnams rim pa ltar snang nyams la rmi lam wal wal 'char/ 'di'i dus phyi'i snang ba rang sor sdod pas snang rkyen grogs su 'char/ nang sgyu lus sdod pas 'khrul pa'i byed spyod dang bral/ gsang ba rlung sems sdod pas rnam rtog 'gyu mi srid/ lam 'di'i skabs tshe'i dus byas kyang chos nyid bar dor 'tshang rgya ba la the tshom med do// 'di ni gong gi chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba las nyams snang thams cad gong du 'phel bas nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba zhes bya'o/ sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yang sngar ltar 'bad de bsgoms pas/ thig le mu khyud lnga ldan gyi ngang du/ zhi khro yab rkyang dang yum bcas dang*/ yab yum zhal sbyar ba lnga tshom dang*/ mthar zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya la sogs pa 'char/ de'i dus phyi rol gyi sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad kyang 'ja' 'od kyi zhing khams su grol/ nang rig pa gzung 'dzin gyi zhen pa 'dzin bral du grol/ gsang ba sgyu lus kyi phung po 'di 'od lus su lam lam 'gyur| 'di las nyams snang 'phel rgyu dang 'char rgyu med cing*/ 'khrul pa thams cad rang zad nas ye shes rgyas/ gdos bcas kyi phung po rang sar nam mkhar sprin ltar dwangs so// 'di ni gong gi nyams gong 'phel gyi 'phel ba zad de/ sku dang zhing khams thams cad ni bre tshad srang tshad la phebs pa ltar 'phel 'grib med par thag chod pas rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba zhes bya'o| |sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: slar yang sngar ltar nyams su blangs pas chos nyid kyi snang ba 'od dang sku rnams 'gag pa dang zad pa med pa ni ma yin no// mi 'gag bzhin du zhen 'dzin grub mtha'i chos zad ces bya ba lam gyi mthar thug pa de 'char te/

de nas lus tha mal gyi gdos bcas zad nas 'od lus su rang yal/ ngag tha mal gyi 'khyal pa zad de gzhom med kyi sgrar rang yal| yid tha mal 'khrul pa'i blo zad nas chos sku spros bral chen por rang yal/ dbang po'i yul kun gyi'ang 'dzin pa las 'das/ bde sdug byed chos byas chos tha snyad ltar snang*/ bcas rang kha na ma tho ba 'jig rten tshur mthong byis blo'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi rtog ge 'khrul blo thams cad rtsad nas zad pa'i chos zad blo zad ces bya'o// de'i tshe 'khrul snang zhing khams su zad/ rang snang bzo med du yal/ ngo bo rang bzhin bzlog /'di ni chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba zhes bya ste/ lam 'di lta bu brtson pa chen pos bsgom na lo gsum dang zla ba bdun gyis lhag med rdo rje'i sku mi 'grub mi srid pa yin no// 'di ni rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bcud thams cad phyung ba yin no// 'di la sdod pa gsum gyis tshad gzung ba dang*/ tho ba gsum gyis gzer gdab pa/ mi 'gul ba gsum la gdeng bca' ba sogs spros pa rgyas pa la dga' na rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid yig gzhan nas kyang kha 'gengs par rung ba yin no// de ltar srog rtsol 'bar 'dzag dang snang ba bzhi mngon sum du nyams su blangs pas gnyis snang gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad rtsad nas 'chad/ 'od lus 'ja' tshon dang chu zla lta bu longs sku nges pa lnga ldan gyi skur grol ba ni/ gsang dbang gi nyams len mthar thug pa yin la/ 'ga' zhig gis gtum mo rkyang pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig snang bzhi kho na nyams len la'ang rtsis che bar byed pa lta zhog /tshul 'di ltar nyams su blang na 'od gsal/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'pho ba/ bar do la sogs pa lam gzhan du nyams len rtsa ba 'gang chen du byed pa gang rnams 'dir shing sdong po'i rtsa ba bcad na/ yal ga shugs la 'byung ba ltar nyams len de rnams la rkang thon du 'bad mi dgos pa shugs zhar gyis nges pa dang myong ba thob par 'gyur ro// rgyud kyi snying po bcud kyi yang tig go// sa ma ya:

rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa sher dbang gi nyams len phyag rgya rnams thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la bzhi/ sbyang ba/ nyams len/ brtan g.yo thams cad lam 'dir 'dus tshul/ gegs sel lo// dang po sbyang ba la gsum/ ngag rlung sbyang ba rdor bzlas dang dgang ba/ lus rtsa gnad sbyang ba 'khrul 'khor/ yid thig le sbyang ba maṇ+ḍal la'o| |dang po ngag rlung sbyang ba rdor bzlas dang dgang ba ni/ rang ya mā rir gsal bas/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa rdo rje'i khu tshur pus steng du bzhag la/ sna bug gis rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ phyir rgyu ba hūm̐ du bsam zhing de nyid la ma yeng bar bzlas pa bya ste/ ci tsam nus kyi bar du rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya'o// dgang ba ni/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i mthar oṃ gyis brngubs la/ rdzogs pa dang lte 'og tu chil gyis mnan/ rgyab rlung yar bsdams la bum pa kha sbyor lte 'og tu bzung*/ sems rtog med du bzhag /de'ang lag pa dpral ba dang pus mo gnyis la lan re re reg cing*/ se gol lan gsum gtogs pa de 'dra re la grangs re re bzhag pa'i brgya phrag gcig tu thub pa bum can rab/ brgyad cu 'bring*/ lnga bcu tha ma'i tshod du bzhag pa yin no// gnyis pa lus rtsa sbyang ba 'khrul 'khor la gnyis/ rtsa ba dang*/ yan lag go// dang po rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor drug ni/ lus gnad rkang pa rdor skyil/ lag pa gnyis sa gnon gyi phyag rgya bya/ rlung bum can kha sbyar lte 'og tu bzung*/ dmigs pa rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal gdab/ mgo bo g.yas skor gsum g.yon skor gsum/ ro stod g.yas skor gsum g.yon skor gsum/ lte ba g.yas skor gsum g.yon skor gsum rnams ni 'khor lo'i 'khrul 'khor ste dang po'o// lus gnad gong ltar la/ snying ga'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus dhū ti'i nang du rlung sems 'dus pa'i mi shigs pa'i thig le 'od lnga 'bar ba yungs 'bru tsam gsal btab rlung dbu mar bcug lus bsrang ba ni/

rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i 'khrul 'khor ste gnyis pa'o// 'di la be con kyi 'khrul 'khor yang zer/ lus rlung gong ltar la/ lto ba mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum 'phul 'then bya/ de dang mnyam du mgo bo yang mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum 'jog pa ni rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i 'khrul 'khor te gsum pa'o// lus gnad gong ltar la/ rlung lte bar bzung snying ga'i thig le rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i skabs ltar la/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur mdun rgyab du brkyang zhing nu khar lan gsum gsum rdeg pa ni ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor te bzhi pa'o// lus rlung gong lta bus lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur g.yas g.yon du brkyangs pa pus mgor lan gsum gsum rdeg pa ni sdigs mdzub kyi 'khrul 'khor te lnga pa'o// lag gnyis sa gnon rlung lte bar bskyil/ lte 'og sor bzhi rtsa gsum 'dus mdor raṃ yig dmar po gtum mo'i me gsal btab nas pho ba g.yas skor gsum g.yon skor gsum/ lag pa g.yas g.yon du brkyangs pa dpung par rdeg /slar lag pa khu tshur dpyi zur shad shad brkyang zhing rkang pa sems skyil gyi 'bebs dang lhan cig bya ba de 'dra lan gsum bya ba gtun shing gi 'khrul 'khor te drug pa'o// gter gzhung las/ phyag rgya drug gis rtsa rnams 'jig /dbu mar rlung sems dwangs mar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa yan lag gi 'khrul 'khor lnga ni/ lus rlung sngar ltar la/ langs pa'i rkang lag bsgrad cing sor mo rnams kyang cher bsgrad pa ni rdo rje gshog pa'i 'khrul 'khor te dang po'o/ lus rlung sngar ltar lag pa gnyis kyis mgo lus rkang pa thams cad la thal zhag rak+ta byug pa lta bu lan gsum gsum bya ba ni byug gsum rdzas kyi 'khrul 'khor te gnyis pa'o// lus rlung snga ma ltar la/ lag gnyis thal rdeb mda' 'gengs g.yas g.yon du gsum gsum bya ba ni glang chen mi lpags 'khrul 'khor te gsum pa'o// lus rlung sngar ltar la/

langs te rdo rje'i khu tshur sta zur thur du brkyangs/ rkang g.yas brkyang bskum gsum dang*/ rgyab mdun du phra ba gsum gsum/ de bzhin rkang g.yon la'ang bya ba ni stag lpags rlon pa'i 'khrul 'khor te bzhi pa'o// lus rlung sngar ltar la/ lag g.yas sor mo brkyangs la mdun du brkyangs pa/ g.yas su bskor la rgyab tu rdeg cing*/ mchan khung g.yas nas mar phyung ba lan gsum/ g.yon la'ang de 'dra gsum/ de rjes khu tshur gnyis 'og tu bcug la rkang g.yas brkyang brdab gsum/ g.yon gsum bya ba ni rigs bzhi sbrul gyi 'khrul 'khor te lnga pa'o// de'ang gter gzhung las/ yan lag 'khrul 'khor bya ba yis// rlung skyon sel zhing yon tan 'phel// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa thig le sbyang ba maṇ+ḍal ni/ sngon du mtshan brjod 'don/ bla ma la yon 'bul/ dbang blangs/ de rjes lus gnad bsam gtan gyi chos bdun dang ldan pas/ rang lus ya mā rir gsal ba'i khong pa'i nang du/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhir gsal ba'i lte 'og sor bzhi rtsa gsum 'dus mdor raṃ yig dmar po gtum mo'i me dang*/ spyi bo tshangs bug gi thad du haṃ yig dkar po'i thad dbu ma lta bu gsal btab/ rlung phyir bus/ nang du rngub/ sbyor ba bzhi ldan du dgang bas ro rkyang gi rlung gis bus pas/ raṃ yig las me 'bar dbu ma'i nang brgyud/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas haṃ las byang sems dkar po bab pa dang me lce mar ded/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor dbus su dkar cha bab/ slar rlung bzung raṃ las me 'bar bas dkar cha yar ded spyi bo haṃ la thim zhing me lce haṃ la reg |de ltar 'bar 'dzag la'ang 'bad/ mthar dkar dmar 'dres pa'i 'khor lo bzhi lus kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad ba spu'i bu ga'i mthar thug pa khrag gis mer gyis gang ba la sems gtad de 'bad pas bde drod gyi nyams rtsal cher 'bar ba 'byung bas de'i tshe mi rtog pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go// sa ma ya:

rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa nyams len dngos la gnyis/ rang lus dang*/ gzhan lus so// dang po rang lus phyag rgya ni/ gong ltar rtsa thig rlung gsum 'byongs nas/ stan bde bar rkang pa rdor skyil lam sems skyil lag gnyis pus mgor rdo rje'i khu tshur bcang*/ rang lus ya mā rir gsal gdab/ rang gi lag pa g.yas sbyor yum dang sor mo lnga de'i bha gar bsam/ gzhan lus kyi skabs ltar mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs/ lag g.yas til mar ram rlan gyis sbags pa rdo rje la 'khyud pa'i tshe/ yab yum liṅga bha gar bcug par bsam zhing*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bde ba'i sgras spyan drangs/ rang gi khong pa'i 'khor lo bzhir bzhugs pa la bde ba bla med mchog gi mchod pa phul bas rtag tu mnyes shing bskyod par bsam la/ dal bde ba chung na rdo rje rtse mo/ 'bring na rked pa/ che na rtsa ba nas bzung la/ bus bskyod/ byang sems spyi bo nas dpral dpral bar dga' ba byas pa las dang po pa'i skabs yin/ 'byongs na mgrin par dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes kyis nyams skyong ba yin/ bar bab pas bde ba ngos bzung*/ ngo bo stong pa'i rang zhal mthong ba'i ye shes/ slar bskyod byang sems mgrin par bab pa'i bde stong gi nyams skyong ba mchog dga'i ye shes/ slar bskyod byang sems snying khar bab pa'i bde stong gi nyams skyong ba dga' bral gyi ye shes/ yang bskyod byang sems lte bar bab cing de'i bde stong gi nyams skyong ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ las dang po pas ni mgrin par sleb pa tsam gyis tshod bzung nyams su blang*/ de dag goms nas snying ga dang lte bar dal gyis rim 'gros su phab/ mthar 'byongs nas cher bskyod/ byang sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor slebs pa 'pho med du bcing*/ slar byang sems gyen du drang ba'i tshe lte bar dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/

mgrin par dga' bral/ dpral bar lhan skyes mthar byang sems spyi bo'i haṃ la bstim zhing bde stong gi nyams skyong*/ de ltar byang sems yas nas 'bebs pa sogs lugs 'byung gi dga' ba bzhi dang*/ mas brtan sogs lugs ldog gi dga' ba bzhi dang*/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor son pa'i tshe/ rang lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ steng rlung rngubs lte bar mnan cing 'phul/ 'og sgo gnyis yar bsdams pa thod pa 'geng ba'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya bas them bu bkag pa ltar 'ching*/ slar rlung de'i ngang nas lce ya rkan la sbyar/ lto ba rgal tshigs la gtad/ yan lag bzhi sgrim/ mig gyen la sgril/ stong 'dren drag po hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes ka 'dzugs kyis drang ba ni/ tsit+ta snying gi phyag rgya zhes sam rdo rje gsod byed kyi 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba ste 'dren gyi mchog yin/ de rjes seng ge rnam rol gyis dgram par bya ste/ seng ge rnam rol ni 'og nas mkhas pa lnga'i skabs 'chad pa ltar bya/ yang na sems skyil rlung kha sbyor byas te gru mo phyogs bcur res mos su lan gsum gsum bskor/ rjes kha sna nas rlung gtong ba dang lus sprug pa lhan cig bya ba ni 'dren 'grem gnyis ka'i man ngag rgyan cha drug gi 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba yin no// gal te des mi thub par 'phor nye na/ dbab bzung ldog 'dren 'grem pa sogs kyi rlung 'khrul 'khor gang dgos gzhan lus kyi skabs bshad pa nas 'dir blang*/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas gnas skabs su lus stobs 'phel zhing 'jig rten pa'i 'dzag bde'i yan lag gi bde ba'i rtsis las 'das pa'i bde stong gi nyams myong rtsol med du 'char/ mthar thug rjes chags dpe'i ye shes mngon du byas pas mtshon nas brjod med don gyi ye shes yan lag bdun ldan gyi sku 'grub par 'gyur ro// de'ang gzhan lus bsten pa'i 'os su ma gyur pa'i nyan thos tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa dang dka' thub la gnas pa dag gis sam/

rnal 'byor pa sngags lam pa yin yang gnas dus kyis gzhan lus bsten pa'i skabs su ma bab pa dag gis lam 'di nyams su blangs pas kyang mchog 'grub la| 'di nyid la brtan pa thob na gzhan lus bsten par gegs mi 'gyur zhing gnad du 'gro ba'i phyir gzhan lus kyi sngon 'gro lta bu yin no// rang lus thabs ldan rang byung gi phyag rgya pho nya'i lam ches zab pa sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa gzhan lus phyag rgya la lnga/ gzhan lus shes rab gsang tig /mdor bsdus mkhas pa lnga/ slar rgyas par bshad pa/ rmad byung gsang ba'i tshe sgrub/ man ngag phyag rgya rnam bzhi bstan pa'o// dang po gzhan lus shes rab gsang tig ni/ rang lus kyi nyams len la goms pa dag gis/ phyag rgya pad+ma can/ dung can ma/ ri mo can/ glang po can/ de bzhi po thabs lam gzhan las 'byung ba ltar brtag nas/ gang yang rung ba rnyed pa na/ rdzas sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor ba man ngag gzhan nas 'byung ba lta bus bkug /khugs shing dbang du gyur nas theg pa thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs/ dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon gyis smin par byas nas/ gnas dben par nyer mkho'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par 'du byas te/ goms par bya phyir phyag rgya la blta ba dang*/ rgod pa la sogs gzugs kyi dpe la bslab/ de'i ngo bo stong nyid du nyams su bskyang*/ de bzhin chags pa'i gtam gleng ba sogs sgra la bslab/ phyag rgya'i lus la dri bzang gis byugs te/ de'i dri ma snom pa sogs dri la bslab/ de'i mchu dang lce 'jib pa sogs ro la bslab/ de la 'khyud pa dang*/ tsum+ba na dang*/ nu ma mnye ba dang*/ rdo rje pad+mar reg pa sogs reg bya la bslab/ de thams cad kyis bde drod skyes pa'i ngo bo stong nyid ro mnyam pa'i nyams bskyang ngo*// de rjes rang ya mā ri dang*/ phyag rgya sbyor yum du mngon rtogs ltar gsal btab pa lha'i 'du shes/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse gcig pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po dang bug pa phaṭa ser pos mtshan pa/

yum gyi mkha' la āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru la āḥdamar po dang*/ sna rtse la muṃ dmar ser gyis mtshan par bsams la sngags kyi 'du shes/ yab yum thabs shes snyoms 'jug rtsa rlung thig le gsum kha sbyor ba bde stong dpe'i ye shes la brten nas zung 'jug don gyi 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang bsgrubs nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par sems pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum la gnas shing tha mal pa'i 'dod chags rnam rtog rgyun bcad de yab kyi g.yas dang yum gyi g.yon 'og tu bcug pa'i glo phab pa'am/ yab rdo rje'i skyil krung gi pang du yum pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'khril zhing yab kyi lag gnyis yum gyi sked pa dang*/ yum gyi lag pa yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pas rdo rje las rung pad+mar dal bus bcug pa'am/ skad cig gis bcug la snyoms par 'jug go// gnyis pa mdor bsdus mkhas pa lnga ni/ bskyod pa la mkhas pa bshad ma thag pa ltar yab yum lhar gsal bas tha mal gyi snang zhen spongs/ bskyod nas 'bebs pa la mkhas pa rus sbal gyi nur 'gros ni dal bus bskyod la bde ba g.yo na bskyod 'phro bshol/ yang bde ba chad na bskyod/ de ltar lan bzhi'am lnga 'bad pas bde ba cher g.yo na/ phab nas 'dzin pa la mkhas pa them rtsa dam por sdom pa lta bu/ steng rlung mnan rgyab rlung bsdams/ sems rang sar bzhag |zin nas 'dren pa la mkhas pa khron chu dpyangs thag gis 'dren pa lta bu ni/ rlung phyir bus phyir bzung dbu ma ka 'dzugs dang nywa bzhi'i sha bsgrim/ mig gyen la ldog /lce ya rkan la sbyar/ ltag pa cher dgye/ 'grengs nas dgram pa la mkhas pa seng ge rnam rol gyi sbyin shugs 'gyed pa lta bu ni/ rlung phyir 'dzin gyis lag gnyis kyi mthe bong gis rna ba gnyis/ mdzub mos mig gnyis/ gung mos sna bug gnyis/ srin mdzub dang mthe'u chung bzhis mchu bsdams la steng rlung ma rngub par mnan nas mgo lus lhan cig g.yas skor gsum g.yon skor gsum byas rjes sor mo rnams dkrol la ha sprug lan gsum bya'o// gsum pa slar rgyas par bshad na ni/

sngar bshad pa'i 'du shes sum ldan gyi ngang las snyoms 'jug srub sbyor gyi sbyor bas byang sems nor bu'i bum pa'i mthar thug par phab nas/ 'dzin 'dren 'grem gsum bya ba la/ 'dzin pa'i gnad gsum ni/ byang sems dpral mgrin snying lte'i 'khor lo bzhir rim gyis phab nas so sor bzung zhing dga' bzhi'i nyams bskyangs/ de'ang bde ba la sems bzung*/ stong pa la sbyar/ steng rlung mnan pas 'og rlung shugs kyis 'gog pa ril ba zhabs tshags can ltar 'bad/ gsus pa rgal tshigs la sbyar/ mig bsgrad/ spyi bor 'jam dpal dbyangs bsgom/ snying thad dbu ma'i nang du dwangs ma mi shigs pa'i thig le rtsa ba'i bla ma la sems gtad/ des ma zin na chos thams cad nam mkha' lta bu ngo bor ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid dang rang sems skad cig gis bsres la phaṭa ces rig pa mkhar bzhag /des kyang ma zin na lag g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis gsang ba'i mgrin pa brtsir te rtsa lam dgag /des mi zin mi srid do// zin nas 'dren pa'i gnad gcig ni/ yan lag bzhi bskum/ gsus pa rgal tshigs la sbyar| lce ya rkan la gtad/ mig gyen la ldog /steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung drag tu yar 'then/ rdo rje'i rtse mor hūm̐ gsum brtsegs bsams la/ pho rlung dgang bsgril gyi stong 'dren drag po ngag tu hūm̐ zhes gdon pa dang sbrags pas rdo rje'i rtse mos hūm̐ yar rang dbang med par snyug sbubs kyis chu 'jib pa ltar drangs pas/ byang sems rdo rje'i bum par ngang phung nge yod pa dbang med par yar phul lte bar slebs/ yang gong ltar hūm̐ dang stong 'dren sbrags pas hūm̐ dang byang sems snying gar slebs/ yang gong ltar drangs pas mgrin pa/ mgrin pa nas spyi bor sbyar bar bsam| spyi bor bla ma gshin rje'i gshed yab yum thig le'i ngo bor bzhugs par bsams la sems gtad/ des mi 'drongs mi srid do// 'drongs na dgram pa'i rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor bdun ni gser g.yu lan tshar lta bu/

lus sgur langs la lag pas rkang mtheb so sor bzung rkang lag bar du rkang gang bzhag /dmigs pa gong ltar la/ thig le spyi bor sbyar ba de rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi brgyud nas lus thams cad la khrems par bsams nas/ ngag tu ha has zhes rlung 'don/ rlung chad tshe mig gyen la ldog /ltag pa dgye/ lce ya rkan la sbyar/ nya bzhi'i shwa bsgrim/ lto ba rgal tshigs la sbyar/ mthar kha sna nas rlung drag tu 'don cing lus thams cad lan gsum sprugs pa ni seng ge'i bzhad tshul zhes bya'o// yang lus sgur khu tshur brla steng bzhag /hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes sna nas rlung snom tshul gyis g.yas g.yon nas gcus/ dbus su drangs nas nang du 'then lto sbyar/ gang ba dang slar 'phul dkrugs pa ni wa mo'i snom tshul zhes bya'o// yang lus sgur lag pa gnyis rkang pa'i bar du gan rkyal du bzhag nas steng 'og gi rlung bzung kha sbyar dkrug cing bsgyur ba lan gsum bya ba ni/ mtshan mos dkyil tshul zhes bya'o| |yang rkang mthil mnyam par bzhag sor mo btsug pus steng lag gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur bzhag /stong 'dren drag pos rgyu zhabs yar 'then zhing ngag tu hriṃ hriṃ zhes brjod/ khu tshur yar gzhogs drud mchan 'og tu slebs nas slar mar gzhogs drud pus steng du khu tshur bzhag /rlung rdzogs pa na lto ba dkrug pa ni ri dwags sprug tshul zhes bya'o// yang lus sgur rkang pa'i bar du mtho gang 'ong bar bya/ lag gnyis mthe bong khu tshur bcangs steng rlung lan gcig mnan rjes/ ngag tu hā ring gi rjes su hag has dbyung zhing rgyu zhabs rgal tshigs la sbyar ba lan gsum dang mthar lus thams cad lan gsum sprug pa ni stag mo'i skyug stangs zhes bya'o// yang lus sgur rkang pa'i bar du khru gang yod par byas la/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor du bzung*/ lus thams cad sil sil sprug pa lan gsum bya/ dbyings rig bsre ba ni g.yang mo'i sprug stangs zhes bya'o// yang lus sgur rkang lag so sor drang por btsug

/bar du khru re lhag tsam yod par bya/ rlung lte 'og kha sbyar bzung*/ rting pa g.yas pas brla g.yas pa'i rtsar sbyar zhing shad shad brkyang ba lan gsum/ g.yon la'ang de 'dra lan gsum/ slar gan rkyal nyal nas rtsib logs g.yas g.yon phab la 'gre/ de rjes rkang lag bzhi lhan cig brkyang brdab bya ba dang*/ rgal tshigs sar phab pa'i lus 'phar ba lan gsum bya/ de'i tshe sems dang rlung mi shigs pa'i thig ler dwangs pa ni gyi ling gi 'phra tshul zhes bya'o// de ltar rlung 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa'i sbyor bas rlung sems thig le 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas su drangs shing dgram mo// rjes su lus sems khong lhod dmigs med bde ba chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de ltar thun bzhi'am drug tu 'bad pas bde stong gi nyams rtsol med du 'char/ ye shes kyi 'od snang 'bad med du rgyas/ don gyi 'od gsal mngon du 'gyur/ ma rig pa sangs nas rig pa ye shes chen por grol/ lus gzi brjid dang ldan/ kun rdzob kyi thig le brtan nas ye shes mchog gi thig ler grol/ dga' ba bcu drug la dbang 'byor/ las rlung 'pho chen re re la stong dang brgyad brgya brgyad brgya re rgyu ba'i 'pho chen bcu gnyis 'gag /mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i skur 'gyur/ 'khor lo bzhir dga' ba re re rdul mun snying stobs kyi dbye bas sa bcu gnyis dang*/ mthar spyi bor brtan pas sa bcu gsum pa 'dir thob/ rang gzhan gyi don thams cad 'bad med du grub pa ni thugs phyag rgya zil gnon gyi yang tig go// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa rmad byung gsang ba'i tshe sgrub ni/ rnal 'byor pa la 'chi ltas byung tshe phyi nang gsang ba'i 'chi bslu'i gdams pa gang nyams su blangs kyang ma bslus na/ phyag rgya pad+ma can yin nges pa btsal/ phyag rgya smin par bya ba dang mkha' gsang byin rlabs sogs gong du bshad pa ltar bya ste/ rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i thugs kar tshe bdag 'od kyi sku mi shigs pa'i thig le'i rang bzhin gyi thugs kar mi 'gyur ba'i srog hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar 'dren pa'i srog a+yai ring gi sngags phreng dmar pos bskor ba/

hūm̐ gi khog par gnas pa'i srog āḥyig dmar nag gi mthar btags pa'i srog rang ming gis bskor bar bsam/ phyag rgya pad+ma can gyi rtsa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar btsal te rnyed pa na/ snyoms par zhugs la phyag rgya'i rtsa sne rang gi rdo rje'i bu gar tshud nges par bcug la bskyod cing*/ bde ba 'bar ba'i tshe byang sems 'pho med du bcings nas/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa bde ba'i sgras bskul ba'i tshe/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna bug gi rlung phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig phyir 'phros/ snang ba snod bcud thams cad āḥdamar po de dang a+yai ring gi sngags phreng gi rnam par gyur pa bkug /rang gi sna bug gi rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig 'ubs kyis drangs nas sa bon sngags phreng dang ming yig rnams la sib sib thim par bsam zhing*/ lus snyoms 'jug /ngag a+yai ring gi bzlas pa/ yid gong ltar dmigs pa dang bcas pa rnam gsum ya ma bral bar nyams su blang*/ mthar 'dzin 'dren 'grem pa'i rlung dmigs 'khrul 'khor gzhan lus su bshad pa gang 'os bya'o// de ltar nyin mtshan thun drug gam bzhir nyams su blang*/ khyad par thig le chen po'i don rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe bsgrub pa ni/ lus gong ltar snyoms 'jug gi ngang nas/ yid dmigs khams gsum srid gsum ma lus pa rang gi khar 'ubs kyis rngubs lte bar bskyil bar bsam zhing kha rlung gis gang ba rngubs la mid pa yang yang bya/ ngag tu/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ ā/ s+thi to hṛ di/ dz+nyā na murti ra haṃ/ bud+dho bud+dhā nāṃ/ t+r+ya dh+wa wartī nāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa duḥkha ts+tshe da/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na murta ye/ dz+nyā na kā ya wā gī shwa ra/ a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥ zhes bzlas pa rnams ya ma bral bar bya/ mthar 'dzin 'dren 'grem pa sogs sngar ltar 'bad/ thun mtshams rnams su rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i mig rdo rje'i mig tu bsams la nam mkhar gtad dbyings rig bsre/

dus rtag tu rang lhar gsal ba'i snying nang du/ rlung sems thig le dwangs ma'i ngo bo mi shigs pa'i thig le 'od 'bar bar ma yeng bar sems gtad do// de ltar nyams su blangs pas na nges par 'chi bdag gi bdud las rgyal ba dang*/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i yon tan rnams thob cing 'od gsal rdo rje sems dpa' grub par gdon mi za'o// khyad par can gyi sbyor ba'o// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: lnga pa man ngag phyag rgya rnam bzhi bstan pa la bzhi/ rtsa btsal ba/ de'i thig le 'bebs pa/ nyi ma drang ba/ rang ngo sprod pa'o// dang po rtsa btsal ba ni/ dben pa'i gnas su rig ma smin par byas nas 'du shes sum ldan gyi ngang nas| gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la bslab pa sngar gzhan lus kyi skabs ltar byas pas/ rang dang rig ma'i khams rgyas pa dang chags pa slong bar 'gyur la/ de'i mthus rang gi rdo rje las su rung zhing*/ rig ma'i rtsa bya rog gi gdong pa can phag pa'i ze ba lta bu ste pad+ma'i nang du cung zad rgyas nas mthong bar 'gyur/ de ltar rtsa rnyed nas mi 'bros par bya ba'i phyir chang zhim po sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bdag dang rig mar bku mnye bya/ ras bal gyi sdong bu sor drug pa shin tu nyol ba zhig byas pa dar 'jam pos dril/ de'i rtse mor 'bru mar dang bya rgod kyi tshil bu sbyar ba byugs pa rig ma'i srin zhal du bcug /mchan khung gnyis su khu tshur dang mnyam pa'i dru gu re re bcug /ras tshar gyis dam lhod ran tsam bsdams/ rgyab nas sga gtad gan rkyal du nyal du bcug pa'i mkhal ma gnyis dang bshang lam lus kyi nang du 'gro/ bha ga phyir 'bur ba'i g.yas dang g.yon du rtsa sne gang 'dug par snyoms par 'jug cing spyad pas/ rtsa sne rdo rje la thug pas rod rod 'byung*/ de'i rtsa sne rdo rje'i bug par chud par byas nas cung zad bskyod pas rig ma bzhin ras dmar zhing sgra 'byin pa dang drod 'bar ba sogs bde ba g.yo ba'i rtags 'byung*/

de'i tshe thig le bsdam zhing 'dzin pa la 'bad/ 'khor lo bzhir drangs/ de ltar yang yang sbyangs/ slar bha ga phye nas bltas pas rtsa sne rib rib mthong zhing pad+ma 'dra ba 'dug na pad+ma can/ dung ltar 'khyil na dung can ma/ ri dwags 'dzing 'thab lta bu ri dwags can/ glang sna ltar 'dug pa glang sna can/ bye thur lta bu rtse phra sked pa cung zad sbom pa ni bde byed ma/ mdud pa ltar 'dug pa ma ning can yin no// de rnams bsten par rung ba'i rigs yin la/ khug ma'i kha phyir bgrad pa lta bu yin na phal pa'i rigs yin te bsten par mi bya'o// de ltar bsten du rung ba'i phyag rgya 'dug na/ ra dkar 'o ma/ ug chos rtsa ba/ da byid/ ka ra/ sbrang rtsi/ khyi tshil/ rtsi dmar rnams sbyar ba'i rtsa sne la byugs/ de'ang rab 'bring tha ma'i bye brag gi rtsa sor drug dang gsum sogs 'byung*/ rtse mo'ang phra ba legs so// de nyid rdo rje'i bu gar bcug nas drangs pas nges par 'drongs la rdo rje yar phul dang*/ 'bol rdo mar 'then pa stabs gcig tu bya/ de ni dam tshig phyag rgya btsal ba'i thabs so// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa rig ma'i thig le 'bebs pa ni/ gong ltar snyoms par 'jug pa rgyun ring du/ rtsa sne rdo rje'i bug par tshud nges kyis spyad pas phyag rgya bde bas rab tu myos te rtsa mig thams cad nas thig le dbyar gyi chu 'brub pa ltar 'bab pa'o// de'ang skabs skabs de ltar spyod/ thun mtshams su tsum+ba na dang 'khyud pa la sogs pa bde ba slong ba'i thabs la 'bad/ rang gi thig le ma nyams par bsrung ngo*// de ni bung ba sbrang rtsi 'tshol ba lta bu las kyi phyag rgya'i thig le 'bebs pa'i thabs so// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa nyi ma drang ba'i thabs ni/ snyug sbubs chu 'dren pa lta bu'i man ngag la rab rtsa'i kha nyid nas drangs te/ rdo rje bha gar bcug /mi bskyod par mnyam par bzhag pas/ rig ma'i thig le 'bab pa'i tshe stong 'dren ka 'dzugs kyis drang ngo*// 'bring rtsa'i bar nas drang ba ni/

drag tu bskyod la bde ba yun ring du bzung*/ mthar bde ba gnyis mnyam gyi steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then/ rkang lag bzhi so sor brkyangs/ rang lus thabs ldan gyis 'dren pa'i skabs ltar 'khrul 'khor bya/ rab 'bring tha ma gsum gar dmigs pa ni/ snyug sbubs kyis chu drangs pa ltar/ rig ma'i dwangs ma mtshal dmar lta bu bcud bzang po de nyid 'ubs kyis drag tu nar nar drang bar dmigs/ gsum ga la 'dren pa'i dus hūm̐ huṃ ring thung dang hīṃ hiṃ zhes ring thung rlung ngag rdzogs par byas la drang*/ de 'dra ba nyer gcig gis rang gi spyi bo'i haṃ la thug par drang ngo*// 'di ni phreng ba lta bu'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya'o// de'i tshe dkar dmar 'dres pa khrag dang 'o ma lta bu rang lus rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa khrigs mer gyis gang bas nyi zla phyogs gcig tu shar ba lta bu'i 'od dkar dmar gyis lus thams cad gang bar bsgom/ de ltar 'bad pas rig ma'i dwangs ma rang gis 'drongs pa'i rtags rdo rje'i mgo bo 'khyog pa dang*/ rang lus sbrid pa dang*/ yum la lus zungs thams cad 'ubs drangs song ba'i snang ba 'char/ de nyid du rig ma'i bde ba yun thung zhing yal na nges par 'drongs pa'i rtags so// chos kyi phyag rgya snyug sbugs kyi chu 'dren pa lta bu'i gdams pa'o| |sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa rang ngo sprod pa ni/ de ltar drangs pas nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bu rtsol med kyi bde chen rang bzhin stong pa chos skur grol lo// de nyid ngos bzung*/ langs te rkang mthil mnyam par bzhag /rlung kha sbyor bzung*/ lus sgur rkang sor rtse nas lag gnyis kyis yar 'then slar 'phong sar phab/ rkang sor lag pas bzung ba spyi bor phyogs bcur bskor| dpung thad g.yas g.yon gyi nam mkhar yang bskor ro// 'phong brdab pa dang mnyam du lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag /de 'dra lan gsum bya ba ni/

be con zhags pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya'o// ngo sprad pa ni/ dwangs ma rab tu lon na rang lus kun drod 'bar/ snying dga'/ the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs ma lus pa chod/ 'bring lon na/ lus kun bde/ zug rngu thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ tha ma lon na snang ba kun bde stong gi sems su gnas par 'gyur ro// de'ang chos nyid nam mkha' ltar yangs pa la/ rig pa ye shes nyi zla ltar 'char/ de nyid dran pa'i ting 'dzin bzo med bcos bral du nyams bskyang*/ khams kyi dwangs ma thig ler smin pas sems stong gsal byang chub snying po rtogs/ yon tan ma lus skyed par byed/ de'ang be con zhags pa'i 'khrul 'khor zin ma thag /lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas sems ma bcos pa bde stong rig pa'i dbyings su gtad pa rnam par grol ba'i 'bras bu 'thob/ phung khams kyi lha thams cad bde bas tshims pas mchod pa thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur/ rang rgyud 'dod chags thams cad rang 'dag /'dzag med bde chen mi 'gyur ba'i zung 'jug de'ang rlung dang sprin yal ba'i nam mkha' lta bu don gyi phyag rgya zil gnon mngon du 'gyur/ snang srid bde bar 'char/ bde ba'i rang bzhin stong par rtogs/ de gnyis dbyer med zung du 'jug /grol ba thar pa rnam grol zhi ba zhi ba gcig pu/ myang 'das zhi ba don dam pa'i myang 'das bde sdug gis ma gos pa/ chags bral lus 'das thub pa dang*/ dpe med pa mtshungs pa med pa che ba 'gyur bral don dam zung 'jug gi skur skad cig la grol bar 'gyur te phyag rgya chen po'i cho ga'o// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de ltar chags lam mthar thug rnam grol legs pa zab cing yangs pa rgya che ba/ theg pa chen po'i yang chen po'i tshul gyi mchog theg pa gsum gyi don mthar thug pa ston pa 'di ni gzhan snod min la ston pa'i gnas skabs gcig kyang med do// gal te snod min la tshig tsam zags kyang las kyi gshin rje rnams dang sngags kyi srung mas gsod par gdon mi za'o// 'di ni zag med bla na med pa'i tshul khrims don dam pa'i 'dul ba chen po ste/

dus mthar gyur pa'i 'gro ba la gsang sngags kyi ming tsam la brten nas bslu ba'i dus gcig 'byung bas/ de dus lam 'di nyid tshul bzhin du ston pa'i slob dpon rig pa 'dzin pa lugs dang mthun par spyod pa rnams dang 'phrad par shog /sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi tha tshig dang smon lam mdzad pa ni gter gzhung 'di nyid du mang du snang ba rnams don bsdus tshig sna bstungs nas bris pa yin no// gsum pa brtan g.yo 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad lam 'dir 'dus tshul ni/ gter gzhung las/ dbang thob lhar gsal rlung la goms// brtag dgug 'du shes gsum ldan rtogs// 'bebs 'dzin 'dren dgram rab tu byang*// ting 'dzin mkha' ltar mnyam par gnas// des ni theg pa kun 'grub 'gyur// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ phyag rgya yum gyi thig le nyid// 'drongs pas dkar dmar 'dres pa yis// 'o ma la ni btsag blugs ltar// thabs shes zung 'jug nus pa yis// bde chen longs sku mngon du 'gyur// skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// da lta nyid du rdzogs sangs rgyas// da lta nyid du rdo rje 'chang*// phyag rgya zil gnon de nyid du// 'tshang rgya ba la the tshom med// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes sogs ches shin tu mang ba gsungs 'dug pa 'dir bris na khrid yig mang bas blo dman rnams 'jug pa mi bde dogs pa dang*/ yi ge'i ngal bas kyang 'jigs pas ma bris so// yid ches nges pa bskyed phyir gter gzhung nyid nas khol bur bcos lhad med par zur du zhal bshus yod pa ltar blta bar byos shig /bzhi pa gegs sel la gsum/ rten dang*/ nyams dang*/ nyams len gsum/ dang po rten gyi gegs sel ni/ phyag rgya brtag nor bas rigs ngan dang phrad pa dang*/ phyag rgya sngon nas rang ngam gzhan la dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ sdom pa zhig pa dang*/ mdze mo dang*/

yug sa mo dang*/ dme mo la sogs pa bsten pas rang gi thig le dang byang chub kyi bar gcod du 'gyur/ lha srung khros shing 'khrugs pas skyon thams cad skyed par byed pas thog mar nas phyag rgya brtag ma nor ba gal shin tu che/ gal te nor ba'am thug phrad stabs nyes kyis phyag rgya bsten nyes na de nyid spangs te/ bskang bshags/ tshogs brgya/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /yig brgya bzlas pa la 'bad/ slar phyag rgya mtshan ldan 'bad pas btsal nas nyams len la 'bad 'bungs snga ma bas bdun 'gyur gyi che ba bya dgos so// gnyis pa nyams pa'i gegs sel ni/ rang dang rig ma lhar gsal ma thebs pa sogs 'du shes gsum las nyams pa'i tha mal du gyur pa dang*/ dga' bzhi'i ye shes ngos ma zin pas 'dod chags rang ga mar song ba dang*/ 'dod sred chags sdang nye tshe ba'i bde ba la blo phyogs pas zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i bde bar song ba rnams la ni sngar ltar bshags sdom bya zhing nyams len la 'bad/ khyad par bde ba'i rten byang sems yin pas yungs 'bru tsam zhig kyang ma nyams pa gal che/ nyams pas yon tan gang yang mi skye ba yin/ gal te yul dus nad gdon la sogs pas dbang med du nyams na de nyid khas btung ngam mdun mthur gyis drang*/ bshags sdom gong ltar bya/ khams gso ba dang*/ thig le spel ba dang*/ stobs bskyed pa dang*/ ro tsa'i rdzas dang*/ sman gang zab yun du bsten pa gal che/ gsum pa nyams len gyi gegs sel ni gnyis/ spyi dang*/ bye brag go// dang po spyi yi gegs sel ba ni/ thig le 'bebs dus ma gzab na myur du 'chor bas shin tu gzab/ snyoms 'jug dang srub sbyor dal bus tshod 'dzin gyin bya/ bde ba 'go g.yos tsam na ngal gso/ phyag rgya rtsa bzang na gzab mi dgos shugs kyis lam du 'gro ba yin/ thig le 'dzin dus ma shor na yon tan yar 'phel yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel/ gang yang mi bde ba mi 'byung*/ zin nas myur du ma ldog na chu dang sdongs nas 'dzag pa grang brum dang mkhal sked kyi nad du 'gyur/

ldog nas myur du ma drang na nad sna tshogs su 'gyur/ drangs nas myur du ma 'grem na 'bras dang 'brum bu dang shu thor gyi nad du 'gyur/ yang na mdze dang 'dra ba dang*/ me dbal dang*/ bas bldags dang*/ sha bkra 'byung*/ mi dmigs pas yongs su ma zin na mtshan bcas kyi dmigs pas thig le rtsa sbugs su 'gril nas mthong snang dang skyon 'ga' 'byung*/ dmigs med ngang du bzhag pas skyon thams cad sel/ rtsa la ma byer na 'bras dang kog shu sogs pags pa'i nad rtags sna tshogs 'byung*/ 'khor lo bzhi'am lngar 'dril na/ 'og sgor dmyal ba/ chu sor yi dwags/ lte bar dud 'gro/ snying gar mi/ mgrin par lha min/ spyi gtsug tu lha ste rigs drug gi 'khrul snang 'char/ chu sor lhung na grang ba skyed/ chu 'gag /grang sel 'byung zhing thig le 'dzag /thig le skam pa dang*/ rul ba dang*/ nyams par gyur na skyon yin pas de sel thabs ni kha zas dang sman bzang po bsten/ yab yum gnyis log lta sogs dam tshig nyams na 'chor bas khrus dang bskang bshags bya/ dbang blang*/ thig le rul ba'i rgyu ni ma khrems pa yin pas de dbyung ba'i thabs rtsa sbyong dang*/ slar thig le gso ba'i ro tsa'i sman yun ring du bsten/ thig le skam pa ni lus stobs nyams pa las 'byung bas bcud len dang sman mar la sogs pa bsten/ dang po gang gis gegs byung yang de'i thad sor stong ra dang khrol tshags bsgom zhing*/ rlung bum can bzung la nad thams cad spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas du ba dang rlangs pa'i rnam pa phyur phyur thon par bsam/ ci'i phyir na snang sems don gcig pa'i gnad kyis shin tu phan par 'gyur ro// rlung bum can gyi rjes su dmigs pa gong ltar dang bcas ngag tu ha has zhes gsung phyir 'don pa man ngag go// stod du thig le'i gegs gang byung yang gtum mor 'bad de bsgoms pas yun bsrings la bya/ smad du thig le'i gegs gang byung yang phyag rgya mtshan ldan bsten nas snyoms 'jug 'dzin 'dren 'grem pa sogs gang du gzhan lus kyi mkhas pa lnga dang rgyas par bshad pa'i skabs ltar nyams len yun bsrings la bya'o// gnyis pa bye brag gi gegs sel ni/

mgo na ba dang*/ mig tsha ba dang*/ rna ba 'on pa dang*/ lce la 'brum pa dang*/ mgul 'gag pa sogs byung na/ gang byung yang steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor bzung*/ chun bcug /bskor zhing dkrug /rjes su kha nas huṃ thung dang has 'bud cing lus sprug /des shin tu bde bar 'gyur ro// stod du dgang zhing gzer ba sogs byung na rlung kha sbyor bzung*/ lag gnyis mdun du thad kar brkyangs la gcu zhing gsig /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis kyis dpung mgor 'jus la gcu/ yang na sems skyil pus mo'i lha ngar lag mthil bkab la rgyab du 'then zhing gcu ba dang*/ mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i phyag rgya rdeg /des skyon thams cad sel bar nges so// smad du na ba dang*/ grang shum dang*/ chu lam tsha ba dang*/ thig le 'dzag pa sogs byung na rlung kha sbyor bzung*/ sems skyil lag gnyis pus steng bzhag /lto ba bskor zhing 'phong brdab/ yang na me thab drug bcing lag pa thab 'gel byas la gtum mo sbar/ des ni skyon thams cad sel zhing smin par 'gyur nges so// rkang lag sogs yan lag na na/ rlung bzung lus dang yan lag gang na ba de gcu zhing mnye ba dang sprug /g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tu yan lag gang na der zhags pa ltar brkyang bskum dang 'phen tshul ci rigs pa byas pas phan no// yang mig nas chu 'dzag pa dang*/ rab rib byung na rlung bzung*/ me stag byas la phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu bskor/ mig bsgrad pa man ngag gi mchog tu bshad do// de rnams byas kyang ma phan na phyag rgya mtshan ldan gyi mkha' nang du bla ma dang ya mā ri'i lha tshogs dngos su bzhugs pa la mchod par bsams nas thig le rul ba de gtang bar bya'o// gal te rtsa nang du ma 'drongs na/ ra dkar mo'i 'o ma dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ pho ba ris/ ka ra rnams sbyar ba drod 'jam bya sgong du blug /bya sgong la bug pa gtod pa'i nang du rdo rje bcug mtshams bag zan sla mos dam du bsdams/ 'og sgor dru gu che chung ran tsam bcug

/bar rlung btsan thabs su rgyas/ mdun rlung 'then/ rgyab rlung rang sor bzhag pas 'drongs/ des ni rtag tu gdong pa dkar zhing gsal/ kha nas 'o ma 'byung bar 'gyur/ yang grang ba shas che na lcam pa'i chu dang 'o ma sbyar ba gong ltar sgong nga'i sbyor ba rdo rjes btung ngo*// yang rtsa sgo dog na lcam pa'i rtsa ba sbug gu dang mnyam pas rim gyis dbye'o// rtsa kha yang na gur gum dang mi'i mkhris pa dron mo rngub lus la bku mnye yang yang bya/ des ni gegs sel bogs thon par 'gyur// 'di rnams ni gegs sel mdor bsdus snying tig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa tshig dbang gi nyams len bsam gyis mi khyab pa ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ yin lugs dang*/ nyams len no// dang po yin lugs la drug /gzhi/ lam/ ngo bo/ rang bzhin/ thugs rje/ ye shes so// dang po gzhi ni/ tha mal gyi shes pa ka nas dag pa zang thal gyi sems can gyi dus ngan du ma song ba/ sangs rgyas kyi dus bzang du ma song ba/ bsal bya'i skyon med pa gdod nas rang bzhin dag pa/ gzhan nas tshur gzhag bya'i yon tan med pa/ yon tan rang la gdod nas rdzogs pa/ gdod nas dag pa rang sems chos kyi sku 'dus ma byas pa lhun gyis grub pa/ gzhan rkyen gyis mi rtogs pa/ bcos ma dang bral ba/ phyogs lhung rtag chad yid byed kyi mtha' dang bral ba ste/ gdod nas skyon spangs pas ka dag /yon tan thams cad rang chas su yod pas lhun grub bo// gnyis pa lam ni/ dbang bzhis rgyud dag cing phung po lnga rigs lnga/ 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i sa bon smin par byas nas de'i rtsal sbyong bog 'don bskyed rim gyis chad pa'i mtha' 'gog /rdzogs rim gyis rtag pa'i mtha' 'gog /steng 'og gi sgo rnam grol pho nya'i lam gyis tshe 'dir 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang tshegs med pa thob par byed pa sngar bstan pa'i lam dbang gsum gyi nyams len dang 'brel ba de nyid do// gsum pa ngo bo ni/

rang sems ka dag rang byung gi ye shes zang thal rang ngo rang gis shes pa 'di nyid yin no// bzhi pa rang bzhin ni/ yon tan rgyun chad med pa lhun grub rang rtsal rdzogs pa gnas lugs don gyi ye shes chos dbyings mtshan ma'i dmigs gtad las 'das pa zab gsal bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes nyid do// lnga pa thugs rje ni/ de'i rang mdangs kun khyab kun la 'jug pa longs sprul dag pa'i sku gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa de'o// drug pa ye shes ni/ chos thams cad gdal khyab mnyam yang ye shes gsum ldan chos kyi dbyings las/ de'i rang rtsal me long la gzugs brnyan gang yang 'char ba/ de thams cad mchog dman bar ma'i phyogs su lhung ba med par mnyam pa nyid du ro gcig pa/ de'ang tshor rig med pa ma yin par 'khor 'das shes bya'i gshis babs thams cad so sor ma 'dres pa'i spu ris phye zhing der snang rnam rtog gi bcos lhad med par so sor rtogs pa/ de thams cad chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du rgya mtshor chu phran ltar dbyer med 'ubs chub bya rtsal rdzogs pa ste/ ji lta ji snyed kun mkhyen pa rang don chos sku/ de'i rang rtsal rang mdangs gdul bya dag pa'i snang ngor nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs sku/ gdul bya cung zad dag pa'i snang ngor mchog gi sprul sku/ gdul bya ches ma dag pa'i snang ngor tha mal gyi sprul pa la sogs pa 'gag med du 'char zhing snang ba gang yin de nyid do// gnyis pa nyams len ni/ bum dbang bskyed rim gyis chos thams cad gsal stong dbyer med/ gsang dbang srog rtsol 'bar 'dzag gtum mos chos thams cad grag stong dbyer med/ sher dbang phyag rgya rnam gnyis snyoms 'jug gis bde stong gnyis med/ tshig dbang bsam gyis mi khyab pas chos thams cad zab gsal gnyis med/ de thams cad dril ba'i nyams len rang sems gsal la 'dzin pa med pa/ stong la ma grub pa med pa| grag la der 'dzin med pa/

stong la sgra min med pa/ bde la chags 'dzin med pa/ stong la chags 'dzin med pa/ zab la 'gag pa med pa/ gsal la rang bzhin med pa/ snang ba'i chos thams cad gsal la snang ba 'dzin pas ma bslad pa'i stong pa dang zung 'jug /snang grag thams cad tshor zhing thos pa der 'dzin gyis ma bslad pa'i stong nyid dang zung 'jug /yid la sems pa bem po 'gyu dran dang bcas pa/ 'khrul blo bzang ngan dang bcas pa rnam rtog gis ma bslad pa'i stong nyid dang zung 'jug /de ltar yang snang grag gi chos thams cad med pa'i stong nyid ma yin pa/ ci med cang med kyi stong pa ma yin pa/ snang grag gi chos thams cad nyi zla'i 'od ltar gsal ba ma yin pa/ 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyang ngo bo'i stong pas ma grub pa/ med pa spangs shing gang ltar snang ba/ de ltar snang bas med dgag spangs pa sogs mdor na chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'dir 'dus pas/ snang ba lhar bskyed pa gsal stong dad pa'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas/ rang sems gsal stong don gyi ye shes/ sgra rlung sngags grag stong dpe'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas/ rang sems gzhom med nā da'i sgra dbyangs grag stong don gyi ye shes/ zag bcas 'dzag bde lam du blang ba kun rdzob bde stong dpe'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas/ rang sems 'gyu bral 'dzag med rgyun chad med pa'i bde ba 'bri gang med pa'i stong nyid zung 'jug don gyi ye shes/ de ltar sngar nyams su blangs pas nyams su myong ba'i gsal stong*/ grag stong*/ bde stong rnams zung 'jug gnyis med kyi ye shes de nyid 'dir rgyun bsrings te/ yin lugs go yul bcos ma'i 'gyu dran mi bsgom par/ myong lugs rang shar rang byung rang sems kyi ngo bo bzo med gcer yan lhug pa so ma rang babs rang gshis rang mdangs rang rtsal thams cad dper na nyi ma la bltas pas ngo bo nyi ma dang de'i rang mdangs 'od gnyis so sor dbye ba med pa ltar sems kyi ngo bo de'i rang rtsal rnam rtog la bzang ngan spang blang dgag sgrub med par rgyar ma chad phyogs su ma lhung bar gang shar bzo med du ma yeng dran pa'i rang so bzung la bsgom pa ni don gyi snying po yin pas so// de ltar mnyam bzhag tu mi rtog pa bsgoms shing*/

rjes shes su bum gsang shes rab kyi dbang don sngar bshad pa rnams 'bad de nyams su blang ba yin no// 'di dag ni sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud kyi yang snying chos sku lag bcangs su blang ba'i yang tig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa yan lag la gsum/ bden pa bzhi'i tshul/ bden pa gnyis kyi tshul/ brtul zhugs spyod pa'i tshul lo// dang po bden pa bzhi'i tshul ni/ gzhi kun 'byung bden pa srid pa bar do/ sdug bsngal bden pa 'chi kha bar do/ lam gyi bden pa rmi lam bar do/ 'gog pa'i bden pa 'pho ba bar do'o// dang po kun 'byung bden pa srid pa bar do ni/ skyes pa nas bzung 'chi ba tshun chad kyi bar do/ sngar bshad pa ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa la nyams len bya zhing*/ snang ba thams cad rang gi sems tsam las grub pa med pa sgyu ma lta bu/ sems kyang sems ma mchis pa gsal stong zung 'jug sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i ngo bor bsam/ yang rang ya mā rir gsal bas phyi snod thams cad gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud skye 'gro lha dang lha mo/ de thams cad kyang med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma'i skyes bu ltar blo sbyang ba sgyu lus/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis brtan g.yo thams cad rang la bsdus pa'i rjes su rang nyid 'jig pa rjes gzhig dang*/ rang lus lhar gsal ba kho na ril po 'od gsal stong nyid du 'dzin pa ril 'dzin/ bsdu lugs de nyid gang rung gis bsdu bas rang sems 'od gsal du mnyam par 'jog pa 'od gsal te/ de gnyis kyang 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang*/ de las lha sku sgyu ma lta bur ldang ba la sogs pa 'jug ldang gi rim pa la bslab par bya'o// nyin par thim rim dang 'od gsal btsan thabs su nyams su blang thabs ches zab pa ni bla ma mnyes pa'i zhal shes so// kun 'byung srid pa bar do'i yang tig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa sdug bsngal bden pa 'chi kha bar do ni/

'chi bar shes pa'i tshe bskyed rim gsal gdab/ nyams chag bshags rang lus tshogs mchod du 'bul| tshe 'di'i snang zhen 'khri ba bcad/ gzhogs g.yas pa phab/ thim rim ngos 'dzin pa dang*/ rjes gzhig ril 'dzin gang rung gis bsdu rim bsgoms pa sbrag /sa thim rim 'di rnams lugs gzhan dang cung zad mi 'dra bar 'di nyid gter gzhung dngos su gsal bar gsungs pa bcos bslad med pa yin pas lugs gzhan pa tsho dang bsre lhad ma byed cig /sa khams su thim pas spyan ma dang*/ rnam snang me long ye shes 'od dkar gsal/ chu chu khams la thim pas mā ma kī/ rin 'byung mnyam nyid 'od ser gsal/ me me khams la thim pas gos dkar/ snang mtha' sor rtog 'od dmar gsal/ rlung rlung khams la thim pas sgrol ma/ don 'grub bya grub 'od ljang gsal/ slar yang sa chu la thim pas snang ba ye shes dga' ba sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin lhun gyis grub/ chu mer thim pas snang ba mched pa mchog dga' longs sku/ me rlung la thim pas snang ba thob pa dga' bral chos sku/ rlung rnam shes la thim pas snang ba nyer thob lhan skyes kyi ye shes bde ba chen po'i sku/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim pas sprin bral gyi nam mkha' lta bu ngo bo nyid sku ye shes kyi snang ba lam me ba/ tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad 'gag pas ngo bo stong pa rnam pa gsal la rang bzhin med pa de ni 'chi ba 'od gsal te/ de las ma g.yos par sangs rgyas byang chub bla med 'thob pa ni sdug bsngal bden pa 'chi ba 'od gsal yang tig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa lam gyi bden pa rmi lam bar do ni/ thog mar gnyid dang bar do rmi lam gyi mtshams su gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal la bslab pa ni/ rang ya mā rir gsal ba khong pa dbu ma'i nang snying thad du rlung sems 'dus pa'i ngo bo mi shigs pa thig le 'od 'bar ba la sems ma yeng ba gtad nas gnyid du btang bas phra rags kyi thim rim ngos zin mthar/

gnyid la song zhing*/ rmi lam bar dor gnyid 'thug med par tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad 'gags pa'i sems gsal stong 'dzin med 'char ba nam mkha' lta bu/ gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal/ tshogs drug 'di la gnyid 'thug cung zad sangs nas 'char ba yin no// gi snang ba ma 'gag pa la der 'dzin gyi rtog pa med pa'i gsal stong ni srab mo'i 'od gsal yin pas de lta bu la sbyang*/ nyams kyi 'od gsal sogs nyi tshe rjes mthun pa yin pas 'dir ma spros so// 'od gsal de ltar zin na rmi lam la nying 'khrul sbyang phyir rmi lam 'dun pas sbyang ba ni/ rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i dbu ma'i nang mgrin pa'i thad oṃ yig pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du/ dmar po 'od 'bar ba la sems gtad/ rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnyid pas rmi lam du shes par 'gyur ro// de'i tshe rmi lam du bskyed rim bsgom pa lus tshad che ba dang chung ba du mar gsal btab la rtsal sbyang*/ gcig las du mar sprul pa dang*/ du ma gcig la bsdu ba sogs sprul pa dang*/ zhi ba khro bo dang khro bo zhi bar bsgyur ba dang*/ rmi lam gyi snang ba thams cad rang sems su tshul bsre/ rang sems rmi lam snang cha phar bsre ba sogs snang ba dang bsre/ rmi lam gyi ngo bo rang bzhin ma grub pa gdod nas grub pa dag pa'i gnas lugs la mnyam par bzhag /gnyid sad pa'i tshe nyin snang thams cad rmi lam gyi dus ltar rtsal sbyang*/ chags zhen 'khri ba'i phung po bcad/ de nas ji bzhin 'gro don byed pa dang*/ phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed pa dang*/ bdud bzhi las rgyal zhing srid pa'i sbyor ba las 'das te 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las mi brgal ka med pa yin no// lam gyi bden pa rmi lam gyi lam yang tig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa 'gog pa'i bden pa 'pho ba'i bar do ni gsum/ rab 'od gsal chos skur 'pho ba sems ni sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba gzhi'i 'od gsal/

nyin mo sems gsal stong 'dzin med 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i nyams len la 'dris pa spyi don gyi 'od gsal/ mtshan mo gnyid dang rmi lam gyi mtshams su gnyid 'thug snang med kyi 'od gsal/ nam mkha' lta bu ni sbas don gyi 'od gsal/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i rgyu ba shi ba las srog rtsol dbu mar gnyid log pa btsan thabs kyi 'od gsal te/ de rnams la goms pa'i rnal 'byor pas ni 'chi ba'i tshe thim rim rnams ngos bzung*/ bdag 'chi ba'i tshe 'od gsal ma bu 'dres te chos skur grol bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang*/ bskyed rim ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gang rung gis bsdus nas 'chi ba'i tshe chos thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid du nges par byas te 'chi ba'i 'od gsal ngos bzung*| rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gag pa'i mthar 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rnal 'byor pa rtsa ngan pa'i rigs ni shi ba'i skad cig ma de nyid dang*/ rtsa 'bring ni zhag gsum dang*| rtsa bzang ba ni zhag zhe gcig gi ring 'od gsal bde ba chen por gnas nas de'i tha mar 'od gsal ma bu dbyer med 'dres te chos skur grol bar 'gyur te tshe 'dir sangs rgyas zhes bya'o| |de lta bu 'byung ba gter gzhung du/ khungs dang rtags dang tshad dang gsum// gcig tu gyur pa'i chos nyid la// gong du 'pho ba kun rdzogs nas// 'od gsal ba la rgyun du gnas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// zhes gsungs pa'i khungs rtags tshad gsum ni tshe 'dir 'od gsal gyi nyams len thos pa dang*/ goms pa dang*/ nyams su myong ba dang gsum yin no| |gnyis pa sgyu lus longs skur 'pho ba ni/ chos thams cad gdod nas med bzhin du snang ba gzhi'i sgyu lus/ rang rig rang gsal 'dzin pa med pa spyi don gyi sgyu lus/ rmi lam gyi snang ba ma grub kyang snang cha ma 'gag pa sbas don gyi sgyu lus la sogs pa sgyu lus kyi nyams len la goms pa dag gis ni/

'chi ba la nye ba'i tshe thim rim ngos bzung bskyed rim rjes gzhig dang ril 'dzin gang rung gis bsdus nas/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags mthar 'chi ba'i 'od gsal ngos ma zin par mthar 'od gsal ma zin pa'i ngang nyer thob kyi snang ba 'char zhing*/ las rlung cung zad g.yos te rnam rtog g.yo bar brtsam pa na/ rang gi nyams len la goms pa'i stobs kyis nga shi bar 'dug /da res 'od gsal ngos ma zin par dran pa nyams te da ni rnam rtog 'khrul pas g.yo bar 'dug pas/ da 'di'i dbang du mi gtang bar sgyu lus longs skur 'pho bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang zhing*/ grogs kyis kyang skabs 'dir 'chi ba po'i rna bar mchu gtad de brda sprad pas kyang dran pa sad nas/ sngar chos thams cad 'od gsal du bcug pa'i mthar bskyed rim sgyu ma lta bu la ldang ba'i rnal 'byor la goms pa'i mthus/ skad cig ma de nyid la bskyed rim sgyu ma lta bu lam gyis bsgoms te de ma thag zhag zhe dgu'i bar bskyed rim la gnas pa bar do med par byas nas de'i mthar bskyed rim de nyid 'od gsal du bcug nas dag pa'i zhing du 'pho ba'am bskyed rim de'i ngang du dag pa'i zhing du phyin par 'gyur te bar do longs skur 'tshang rgya ba zhes so// gsum pa zung 'jug sprul skur 'pho ba la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po sbyang ba ni/ rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i sku'i nang du rtsa dbu ma yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa'i mar sner yaṃ sngo skya/ lte bar hika ljang khu/ snying gar sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag /tshangs bug tu sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar oṃ āḥhūm̐ brtsegs mar gnas pa/ 'tshogs ma/ smin mtshams/ mig /rna ba/ sna| kha/ lte ba/ chu lam/ 'og sgo ste sgo dgur hūm̐ nag po me 'bar ba re res bkag par bsam/ lus gnad rdor skyil sems skyil lag gnyis pus mo la bkab pa'am bsnol bas dpung pa la bzung*/

dmigs pa gong ltar dang*/ rlung gnas hika ces ngag tu brjod pa dang*/ rlung mig sems gsum gyen la gtad/ lto ba sgal tshigs la sbyar/ 'phong cung zad bteg pa'i stong 'dren drag po byas pa'i tshe gsang gnas kyi yaṃ rlung gis g.yos pas yar myur bar 'ong bas hika phul/ yaṃ dang hika yar 'ong bas hūm̐ phul nas tshangs bug tu sna tshogs rdo rje la thug /sna tshogs rdo rje 'degs la khad par bsam zhing hika drag po nyer gcig gis mgrin par/ nyer gcig gis tshangs bug tu bskyal/ slar kā zhes rlung mig sems gsum mar phab cing yi ge rnams rang gnas su slebs par bsam/ de ltar sbyangs pas 'byongs pa'i rtags 'pho ba gzhan ltar 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ 'chi ba la nges par thug pa'i tshe/ rang ya mā rir gsal ba bsdus nas/ rang lus yi dam la tshogs mchod du phul/ rtsa dbu ma kho na gsal ba yi ge rnams dmigs pa'am/ rang lus tha mal pa'i khong pa'i nang du rtsa dbu ma dang sa bon rnams gsal btab cing hika drag pos bskul ba'i tshe/ yaṃ hika la thim/ hika hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i yi ge gsum la thim ma thag /sna tshogs rdo rje 'ja' yal ba ltar song*/ yi ge gsum hūm̐ āḥl thim/ āḥ.oṃ la thim/ oṃ mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas 'od gsal la 'jug gam bskyed rim du ldang ba sogs tshe 'di'i nyams len goms 'dris gang che ba de ltar bsgom/ 'pho ba'i tshe hika gi mthar/ 'chi ba po dran pa nyams shing 'phor nye ba'i ngag nas hika 'byung bar mi nus pa'i tshe grogs kyis phaṭa drag pos spar ro// 'di dag ni 'od gsal dang sgyu lus la brtan pa ma thob pas dmigs rlung zung du 'jug pas sprul skur 'pho ba yin no// gzhan yang bar do'i nyams len bar do ngos bzung ba dang*/ 'gegs pa dang*/ mngal sgo 'gag pa dang*/ mngal 'dams pa sogs ni gong gi 'pho ba gsum gang rung la nges pa rnyed nas bar do'i nyams len cher med kyang rung bas ma sbyar la/

de'ang 'pho ba snga ma gnyis gang rung la goms na nges par bar do'i nyams len mi dgos mod/ 'pho ba phyi ma tsam la goms pas kyang bar do'i nyams len bya bar 'dod na man ngag gzhan ltar 'dir sbyar du rung ba yin no| |'gog bden 'pho ba'i yang tig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa bden gnyis kyi tshul la gnyis/ ma rtogs log rtog phyogs rtogs kun rdzob bden pa/ legs par rtogs pa don dam pa'i bden pa'o// dang po la gsum/ ma rtogs pa ni 'khor ba'i sems can rnams bde ba 'dod kyang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba mi sgrub/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba sgrub/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par ma shes par bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pas 'khor ba las ma 'das pa rnams so// gnyis pa log par rtog pa ni/ phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams la lta log sum brgya drug cu dang*/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu la sogs pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ bon la sogs pa rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bka' la rnam par mi bden par 'dzin pa gang yin pa rnams so// gsum pa phyogs tsam rtogs pa ni/ nyan thos pa dag 'khor ba la 'jigs pa dang myang 'das la dad pas phyogs tsam rtogs kyang gzhan phan gyi snying rje chung zhing stong nyid la mi mos pas ma rtogs pa dang*/ rang rgyal rnams 'khor bar 'jigs/ myang 'das la dad/ dben pa la dga' bas phyogs tsam rtogs kyang gzhan phan gyi snying rje chung zhing nga rgyal che ba dang*/ slob dpon la gsang ba sogs ma rtogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang nyan thos rnams rnam par bam pa dang*/ rul ba la sogs pa'i 'du shes sgom pa dang*/ lta ba sdong dum mes tshigs pa lta bu dang*/ rang rgyal rnams rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'byung ldog sgom pa dang*/ theg chen gyi lam la mi mos pa sogs kyis phyogs tsam rtogs kyang dpyis phyin pa ma rtogs pa rnams so// de ltar na de dag thams cad rang snang log pa'i chos kun rdzob bden pa rdzun ma bslu ba'i chos 'jig pa dang bcas pa ste/

de rnams la rmi lam lta bu dang brtse ba'i sems kyis yang dag pa'i lam la bkri ba dang*/ phan pa dang bde ba'i dga' ston rtag par ma nyams par sbyin par bya ste/ kun la phan pa'i gang zag dper bya kun las 'das pa yang dag pa'i chos kyi sbyin bdag chen po bya ba'i khur khyer nas/ gzhan phan la 'bad par bya'o// gnyis pa legs par rtogs pa don dam bden pa ni/ rang byung rang shar rang gi sems nyid ni/ gdod nas skye ba med pa byang chub kyi sems/ sangs rgyas kun gyis rtogs par bya ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub bla na med pa/ nam mkha' lta bu kun la khyab pa/ me long ltar thams cad snang ba/ sems dang rnam shes rgyud dang ldan pa/ nam mkha' ltar chags thogs med pa/ phywa dang dbang phyug byed po med cing gang gis kyang byas pa med pa dang*/ rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ste/ 'di nyid rtogs na 'khor ba'i ming tsam yang gdod nas med cing*/ kun btags kyi dug lnga po kun rtog gis der 'dzin spangs pa mya ngan las 'das pa chen po nyid yin la/ de'ang gter gzhung las/ nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bsgom// chos nyid kyi ni bden pa'o// zhes dang*/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud du// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med| |bzhag par bya ba'ang cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes dang*/ mgon po byams pas mngon rtogs rgyan du'ang de kho na gsungs pas sems kyi gshis babs rang babs su skyong zhing*/ de'ang bsal bya'i skyon gdod nas spangs/ bzhag bya'i yon tan gdod nas rang chas las gzhan med pa/ yang dag pa'i ngo bo nyid la rnam rtog der 'dzin spang gnyen dgag sgrub med par yang dag par rang babs gcer yan du blta ba ni/ mdo sngags gnyis ka'i nyams len gyi gnad gcig tu dril ba ste/ ji skad du/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab// ces pa'i don 'ba' zhig go// 'di ni nges pa'i don gyi chos te chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa'o// bden pa gnyis kyi yang tig sa ma ya:
