rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa brtul zhugs spyod pa la lnga/ brtul zhugs dngos goms nas brtan phyir rlung gi bzlas pa/ lam gyi rkyen bcud len/ bzla ba'i sngags/ ya ma bzhi'i grub tshul lo// dang po brtul zhugs dngos la lnga/ ma goms pa/ goms pa/ rab tu goms pa/ mchog tu goms pa'o| |dang po ma goms pa las dang po pa dag gis/ tshangs par spyod pa'i sdom pa la gnas par byas la/ sems bskyed nas bzung dbang bzhi'i nyams len rnams snga ma la drod thob rim gyis phyi ma nyams su blang ngo*/ gnyis pa goms pa dag gis/ tshangs spyod la ma ltos par lam rim pa gnyis nyams su blang zhing sngags kyi spyod pa gsang nas spyad/ gsum pa shin tu goms pas dur khrod dang bas mtha' la sogs pa dben par ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ glang lpags kyis bgo ba/ ha hā hi hī la sogs pa'i sgra sgrog pa dang*/ stag dang seng ge glang chen la sogs la lam mi gzur zhing*/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i dpung dang phrad kyang phyag mi 'tshal/ ya nga dang rnam rtog thams cad spang ngo*// bzhi pa rab tu goms pas 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i chos thams cad nam mkha' lta bur blta zhing*/ za nyal 'gro chags thams cad mnyam bzhag las ma g.yos pa/ dwangs ma'i ye shes 'od gsal bde ba chen po gcig pu nyid ma gtogs/ gzhan gyi mchod pa sogs 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos thams cad spangs te zla ba drug spyad do// lnga pa mchog tu goms pas ni/ brtan g.yo kun rtog srid pa'i dra ba thams cad bcom/ nyon mongs ma lus zhi/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal/ rnam dag legs pa'i lam bgrod/ sangs rgyas byang chub bla med thob zin pas brtul zhugs spyod pa sogs bya byed thams cad byed pa dang bral bas rang don phun tshogs grub zin gzhan don 'bad med du 'byung bar 'gyur ro// brtul zhugs kyi yang tig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa brtan phyir rlung gi bzlas pa bya/ bskyed rdzogs la goms nas brtan pa'i phyir thun mtshams su bzlas pa bya ba'i phyir rlung gi bzlas pa yan lag dang bcas pa ni/

rdo rje ru rak+sha'i phreng ba 'chang*/ rdo rje rus pa'i rgyan dang thal zhag khrag gis byug par bya/ ras gos dang stag lpags gyon/ dom dang ma he'i pags pa la gdan bya/ sha chen la sogs pa sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga sbyang spel sbar ba'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs la longs spyad/ rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i thugs ka'i dwangs ma mi shigs thig le'i dbus su bya grub ye shes a+yai/ de mthar stong srog a+yai ring gi sngags phreng gis bskor/ de las 'od 'phros/ stong gsum skus gang de thams cad kyis sngags sgra sgrog /don gyi ngo bo ya mtha' rdo rje sems dpa' nas ma mtha' the'u rang 'byung po bar gyi stong srog mi 'gyur ba chos dbyings bde ba chen po gsal stong 'dzin med las mi g.yo ba las slar 'od 'phros/ stong gsum gang ba'i sku dang sngags sgra rnams tshur 'dus/ snying nang mi shigs pa'i thig le dwangs ma 'od lnga la thim| 'khor 'das gnyis med don gyi ngo bo la mnyam par bzhag /rlung 'jug gnas gsum sgra grag thams cad grag stong sngags kyi sgra dbyangs gzhom med rdo rje'i bzlas pa blta'o// de ni yan lag mchog gi lam sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog gi yang tig go// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa lam gyi cha rkyen bcud len ni/ sngags kyi yan lag lnga rdzogs nas/ mi dang phag dang khyi dang rta dang ma he rnams kyi sha ma rul ma sungs pa dang*/ gu gul/ dzā ti/ li shi rnams phye mar byas pa nas kyi phye ma dang sbyar ba'i thug pa drod dang ldan pa/ srin zhal snyug sbubs kyis rgyab rlung ka 'dzugs kyi sbyor bas brngubs te/ de dag bstan dgra zhing bcu bsgral ba'i sha khrag zag med kyi bdud rtsir bsams la 'thung*/ des ni lus gzi brjid dang ldan zhing blta na sdug pa dang*| yon tan dang ldan zhing yon tan shes pa sogs 'byung ngo*// lam gyi cha lag bcud len yang tig go// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:

bzhi pa bzla bya'i sngags ni/ ru rak+sha'i phreng ba byin rlabs byas pa thogs nas stong srog tsheg bar brgya dang zhe dgu tshang ba dang*/ a+ye thung bcu dgu pa dang*/ sku'i sngags bcu gsum pa dang*/ gsung gi sngags bcu gnyis pa/ thugs kyi sngags brgyad pa/ a kro dang ya ma bcu bdun pa/ a kro bcu gcig pa/ las sbyor rtsa ba'i sngags la sogs pa 'dogs dbyung man ngag gi gnad slob dpon dgyes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba kho na la ltos pa rnams ma 'khrul bar zhus te thun mtshams thams cad du bar med du bzla/ de'i tshe rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i thugs srog 'od kyi gsang rum nas/ yi ge 'od kyi 'phro 'dus/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa sbyangs/ thams cad zil gnon sku sngags sgra sgrog pa/ thugs mchog dwangs ma 'od du 'bar ba/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sngags kyis mchod/ rgyud drug bag chags rtsad nas sbyangs/ slar 'dus thams cad bdag gi thugs kar thim/ 'khor 'das dbyer med phyag rgya zil gnon ye shes chen po'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag cing sngags rnams bzla/ 'di ni khams gsum yongs sgrol gsang sngags sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum 'dus pa/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi ngo bo/ bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel byed 'di las gzhan pa'i gsang sngags ma byung mi 'byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul gcig pu/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis gsungs shing gsungs la gsung bar 'gyur ba sogs che ba'i yon tan mtha' yas pa gter gzhung nyid du 'dug go// sngags kyi yang tig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: lnga pa ya ma bzhi'i grub tshul ni/ 'di la gter gzhung du gdod nas yongs grub kyi sbyar bshad mang du gsungs nas/ nyams len ni/ rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i dpral bar 'khor lo/ mgrin par pad+ma/ thugs kar rgya gram/

de gsum gyi dbus su a+yai yig gsum las dpral bar sku/ mgrin par gsung*/ snying gar thugs kyi sngags rnams sngar bzla bya'i sngags kyi dus bshad pa de gsum gyis so sor bskor ba/ sngags bzlas pas khams gsum chos skur grol/ rnam pa sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ dpral bar gzugs med sbyong byed a+yai chos sku'i ya ma lhun gyis grub pa'o// mgrin par gzugs khams sbyong byed a+yai longs sku'i ya ma lhun gyis grub/ gsang bar 'dod khams sbyong byed a+yai sprul sku'i ya ma lhun gyis grub/ snying nang dag pa chos dbyings tsit+ta ga'u'i nang du a+yai rang byung ye shes kyi ya ma lhun gyis grub pa'o// de bsgom pa ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas pa zin nas/ rang gi spyi bo tshangs bug /mgrin pa/ snying ga /gsang gnas rnams su a dang ya brtsegs pa ais brgyan pa yi ge gsum sku gsum gyi bdag nyid can re re gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa sku bzhi'i ya ma bzhir rang chas su grub pa de nyid la sems gtad nas mnyam par bzhag go// 'di ni bsam gtan gyi yan lag kun shes pa dang*/ ting 'dzin rig cing rgyud rig pa/ longs sku rgyal ba kun gyi spyi mes dang*/ sprul pa'i skus stong gsum phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed pa/ rnam dag legs pa'i lam zab cing rgya che ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul yin pas so// ya ma bzhi'i yang tig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ mnyam bzhag skyong tshul dang rjes thob bo// dang po mnyam bzhag skyong tshul ni/ sngar bshad pa'i rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor de nyid las dang po pas thog mar zla ba drug gi bar du ngag mi tshig dang ma 'dres par thun drug tu bcad la nyams su len pa gal che ste/ las dang po pas rnal 'byor srangs su tshud par bya ba'i don yin no// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa rjes thob la lnga/ nyal ba/ ldang ba/ kha zas/ gtor ma/

spyod lam mo// dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ chos thams cad sems su thag bcad/ snang srid thams cad lhun grub 'od kyi rgya mtshor skyil/ de rnams bdag zil gnon du gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs la bsdus te dwangs ma 'od kyi khang bur bzhugs/ rdo rje mkhar du gnas pa spyang mo drug gis go mtshams bsdams/ mchod rten gsum gyi khang bzang du rnal 'byor spyod pa spyad de rtog med chos skur lam sbyang*/ 'chi srid sbyong ba'i man ngag sngar bshad pa'i gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal dang rmi lam 'dzin pa'i nyams len rnams bya'o// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ snying nang stong gsal don gyi ga'u na/ rig pa skyon bral phyag rgya chen po zil gnon don gyi sangs rgyas bzhugs pa la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i rang byung gsang sngags kyi sgra srog rtsol gyi rlung dang dbyer med pa gzhom med rdo rje'i glu blang ba'i tshig gis bskul bas 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ngang nas/ skad cig gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas phyag rgya zil gnon gyi sku sgyu ma lta bur ldang zhing*/ de'ang snod kyi 'jig rten drag po e yi gzhal yas/ bcud kyi sems can skye 'gro'i gzugs bar do'i shes pa lha'i skur ldang ba skye srid sbyong ba'i man ngag dang ldan pas ldang ngo*// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa bza' btung gi rnal 'byor ni/ bza' btung gang byed a+ye thung gi sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs 'dod yon gyi lha mor dmigs/ zag med bde ba'i bcud du bsam/ rang lhar gsal ba la lha thim pa'i tshul du bsams la longs spyad/ yang na gsang gtum thig le'i mchod pa chen po'i mchod pas lus sems brtas shing bar gcod sel/ tshogs rdzogs/ dbang gi ye shes 'phel lo// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma dngos su 'byor ram yid kyis sprul la/ sngags 'dis zag med kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/

oṃ sarba dharma a bhā wa swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe badz+ra tsak+ṣuḥ.a ā aṃ aḥ pra kṛ ti pa ri shud+dhaḥsarba dharma ya du ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya mañdzu shrī pa ri shud+dhi tā mu pā dā ya tī aṃ aḥ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbha ga wān dz+nyā na murti wā gī shwa ra/ ma hā wā tsa sarba dharma/ ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shud+dha/ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥ zhes lan gsum/ rang gi mig g.yas nyi ma/ g.yon zla bar gyur pa'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu nas gtor mgron zil gnon gyi lha tshogs dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa thams cad skad cig la bkug /mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ljags las 'od zer byung bas/ gtor ma e nang zhal gyi dkyil 'khor du gsol bas bag chags ma lus pa sbyang bar bsam/ a+yai ring gi gsham du/ ma hā pañtsa ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/ 'dud nyi shu pas bstod/ phrin las gang 'dod gsol/ dam tshig pa rang gnas oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang gi gsang rum du thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yon tan phrin las gtor mas sgrub pa'i yang tig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: lnga pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la gnyis/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa'o// dang po thun mong ba'i spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la bzhi| tshogs spyod/ gsang spyod/ rigs spyod/ kun 'dar spyod pa'o// dang po tshogs kyi spyod lam ni/ tshangs par spyod pa'i sdom pa la gnas par bya/ slob dpon mkhas pa bsten te rig pa bslab/ nyan pa dang sems lhur blang*/ sgom pa shugs la rnyed par bya/ de'ang rim gyis pa dang cig car ba gnyis las/ rim gyis pas dge 'dun gtsang sbyor gyi sde la 'dug /so thar ris bdun gang rung gi sdom pa blang*/ de'i lta spyod nyams len dri ma med pa la sbyang ba dang bsam pa bsgom par bya/ nges 'byung gsum la bslab/ de goms nas theg chen la bslab/ rang gzhan gyi don du smon 'jug gi sems bskyed mnos la/

mdo 'dul mngon pa la bslab/ rtag tu gzhan don 'ba' zhig bsam/ byams snying rje la 'bad/ phan bde ster ba'i kun rdzob byang sems dang*/ gnas lugs stong nyid don dam byang sems bsgom/ spyod lam kun tu yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin nyan 'chad don sems klog dang kha ton dang gzhan la ston pa la 'bad/ so thar dang byang sems gnyis kar dag pa'i gos dang gtsang ma'i kha zas ma gtogs pa dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor dang sku glud/ sha khrag chang sgog btsong la phug dus min gyi zas sman du gyur na ma gtogs spang*/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon mtshan ldan las dbang blangs nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma nyams bsam sgom 'dzin zlos bsrung la 'bad/ rgyud sde klog /gsang ba'i rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga brda tsam bsten/ bag med pa'i kha zas spang*/ rdor dril la sogs phyag mtshan rnams dang*/ rgyan chas byug pa/ thod pa/ thod rnga/ bris sku/ rgyud kyi glegs bam/ dgang blugs/ dam rdzas/ bgrang phreng la sogs pa mkho zhing dam tshig gi yo byad thams cad mis mi mthong bar bcang zhing dgos dus longs spyod/ de rnams kyis 'phyor chas dang ngom g.yel mi bya/ lha sngags ting 'dzin nyams rtogs drod rtags thams cad rtsa ba'i slob dpon ma gtogs pa la gsang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo spang na dam can mkha' 'gro 'khrug |chos dang slob dpon gyi dam las 'gal/ dngos grub kyi bar chad du 'gyur bas ma chag par bya/ de'ang gshin rje'i gshed kyi bshad rgyud khri drug stong pa las/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo nya stong brgyad// nyi shu gnyis sogs dus la bya// zhes gsungs pas/ gshin rje'i gshed la yi dam du bya ba dag gis tshogs kyi 'khor lo yar ngos tshes brgyad dang bco lnga mar ngo'i nyer gnyis dang stong la bya/ gsang sngags khrom du bsgrags pa dang nor ba dang sud pas gsang sngags nyams/ des gza' skar 'khrugs te mtha' dmag dang mu ge dang ma nyes pa'i kha yog dang dgra rkun ldang*|

de rnams ni dmyal bar skye ba'i snga rtags yin pas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i bstan par dus kun spyod lam gzab pa gal che'o// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa gsang spyod ni/ tshogs spyod la drod thob nas dben gnas dur khrod/ gangs ltongs/ nags khrod/ ri rtse la sogs pa skye bos dben pa'i sa phyogs su thun drug tu bcad la nyams su blang*/ ting 'dzin rtsa rlung thig le ye shes la cung zad goms pa'i rtags thon nas/ nub mo zhing glang stag lpags rnam gsum gyon/ phyag rgya lnga dang byug pa gsum dang sbrul nag gi thod dang*/ rnam snang klad pa khrag chen lus la byug /skra bcings be con thogs/ ha hā zhes sgrog cing cang te'u brdung*/ dur khrod dang sha za yi dwags kyi gnas su nam srod la 'gro lam nyams su blangs/ nam gung yol nas rang gnas su log /de ltar zla ba drug spyad pas rtsa rlung la goms shing bskyed rdzogs la drod thob nas/ lus tha mal gyi snang zhen dang*/ sems 'khrul pa'i chos cung zad pa na/ pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya rgyal khams kun nyul la btsal zhing brtags la bkug /yang na rig sngags kyi mthus lha klu gdol pa mo sogs gzhan gyis bdag gir byas pa dbye 'am mi dbye yang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang rang gi rlung sems ye shes kyi mthus bkug la zla ba gcig gam drug tu sbas la bsten/ brtag pa dang*/ dgug pa dang*/ bsgyur ba/ smin par byed pa shin tu gal che'o// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa rigs spyod ni/ rim pa gnyis po phyi nang gsang ba rtag tu goms shing nyams pa med par 'phel zhing goms par gyur nas 'khrul pa'i chos tha snyad dang*/ rim pa khrigs chags blo'i chos dang*/ ngo tsha bag tsha bcos ma'i chos dang*/ nges 'byung sogs btags pa'i chos thams cad 'khrul pa yin par shes nas/ nges med du za ba dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ 'chag pa dang*/ res 'ga' lkugs pa lta bu/ res 'ga' smyon pa lta bu/

res 'ga' bya ba kun dang bral ba ro lta bu/ res 'ga' grong khyer dang tshong 'dus sogs su phyin la khyi phag lta bu 'dug pa/ dus rtag tu mthun pa'i tshig mi smra ba/ lam rim gnyis dang ma bral ba de 'dra zla ba drug spyad pas/ ting nge 'dzin dang rgyud rig pa tshor drug bde ba 'bar/ de nyid stong par shes nas longs spyod rdzogs sku kun gyi rgyal po rtogs par 'gyur la/ de ltar gyur ma gyur rig pas dpyad la 'tsham par ma spyad na spyod pa bo zags su 'gyur ro| |sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa kun 'dar spyod pa ni/ brtan g.yo'i lam rtogs goms nas rab tu bya sla ba'i phyir/ gnas 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ nyam nga ba'i sar 'dug /bzar mi rung ba'i dug kyang bza'/ sha dang khrag smos ci dgos/ thams cad stong nyid du rtogs pas gtsang dme ci'i phyir yod/ btung min dug kyang btung*/ bshang gci la sogs smos ci dgos/ thams cad bde chen ye shes yin pas spang blang thams cad ci'i phyir bya/ rlung sems dhū tir tshud pas gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa ci'i phyir yod/ khrag rgyun ldan pa'i mi lpags dang*/ thod pa khrag gis gang ba sogs rtag tu bcang*/ stong nyid mngon du gyur pas rdo rje 'chang rgyal nyid yin pa'i phyir rdo rje 'jigs byed tsam yang 'jigs par byed na gzhan lta ci smos/ bdud bzhi thul bas rigs drug nyam mi nga*/ gnas la nges pa med pas ngam grog dang g.yang sa gang yang der med/ gzung 'dzin spangs pas bar do skye 'chi la sogs pa des mi mthong*/ de ni rnam dag legs pa'i lam ste/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang 'theb sen mo'i khyon gyis kyang tshangs pa'i g.yul sa rtse nas gnon la/ sems can kun don la spyod cing*/ 'khor ba thams cad 'joms pa'i dbang phyug /bcos ma kun dang bral ba rnal 'byor spyod pa mthar phyin pa'o// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa ni/

rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi po yan lag dang bcas pa mthar phyin/ drod thob/ mngon du gyur nas gnas la nges med gar sdod kyang thams cad mnyam pa chen po/ gos nges med gang gyon yang kun tu zhen pa med pa/ zas nges med gang zas kyang thams cad mnyam pa nyid du bdud rtsi/ bzang ngan gyi rtog pa kun dang bral ba bstod smad dga' sdug la khyad med pa/ thams cad grub pa dang ma grub pa med pa/ bya ba zin pa dang ma zin pa med pa/ mdor na 'khor 'das brtan g.yo thams cad don dam pa'i phyag rgya zil gnon gyi ye shes yin pa bcos min du rtogs shing grol/ de thams cad 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i rgyal tshab gzhon nu yin nges la/ de ni don grub bsam pa 'grub pa ste/ drod thob spyod pa tsam byas pas rigs kyi dngos grub da lta nyid du thob par 'gyur la gsang sngags rigs chen 'di nyid gnas pa de ni/ gsang sngags gzhan thams cad dang*/ rig sngags/ gzungs sngags thams cad 'chang ba'i rigs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba las grol ba/ nyan rang sogs theg dman las thar ba/ phar phyin theg pa sogs rgyu'i theg pa las rnam par grol ba/ zag bcas thams cad las grol ba/ zhi ba/ lam gzhan la'ang bsten mi dgos pas kyang zhi ba/ gang la'ang 'jigs pa med pas legs par mya ngan las 'das pa dang nye ba 'di ni lam 'di nyid las 'byung bas na tshul chen po 'di la ni lam gzhan gang gis kyang dring mi 'jog pa yin no// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yang gang zag cig car ba ni/ so byang la sogs pa'i lam thun mong ba la 'jug mi dgos te/ thog mar rdo rje slob dpon mtshan ldan la mnyes par byas nas/ dbang dang dam tshig thob par byas pa bsrung zhing lam 'di nyid mnos te tshul dang ldan par lus ngag yid gsum 'bad pa drag pos zla ba drug nyams su blangs/ de rjes gong ltar spyod pa spyad/ yang dbang gi dus kyi ye shes ngo 'phrod de don gyi drod thob na de la spyod pa spyad pas mthong lam gyi ye shes thob pa gsal zhing brtan par gyur nas zhag bdun 'bad pa drag pos lam nyams su blangs pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur la/

dbang gi thob mthar brtan nas phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin 'grub/ de la kun bzang gi spyod pa spyad pa'ang gsungs so// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa gnad dus la gsum/ nyin mtshan dus drug gi rnam dbye/ dus ji tsam gyis grol ba/ lam 'di dus bab kyi gdams pa yin zhing zab par gdams pa'o// dang po nyin mtshan dus drug gi rnam dbye ni/ gter gzhung las/ dgung gnyis gnyid dang bya ba spyad// thun bzhi'i dang po lta ba bskyang*// gnyis pa rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom| |gsum pa lha bsgom bzlas brjod bya// bzhi pa chos spyod bcu la 'bad// rgyaḥ dang po lha la thun gcig blta// gnyis pa yid kyi yul du blang*// gsum pa rnam dag nga rgyal gzung*| |bzhi pa bzlas brjod rlung dang bsre// rgyaḥ dang po rtog med rten la gtad// gnyis pa zhi gnas yang yang bskyar// gsum pa lhag mthong shes rab bskyed// bzhi pa zung 'jug 'khor mtha' spyad// rgya: dang po lus mnye rlung ro bsal// gnyis pa lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor bya// gsum pa gtum mo chags chen bsgom// bzhi pa rtsal sbyong lta ba skyong*// rgya: dang po dpe lta tshig rnams gzung*// gnyis pa dpe 'bri zhus tig bya// gsum pa kha ton bya zhing sbyang*// bzhi pa bskyed rdzogs don la 'jug /rgya: dpyid gsum ri thang mtshams su bsgom| |dbyar gsum ri rtse mtho sar bsgom// ston gsum spang stod dben par bsgom// dgun gsum lung stong dben par bsgom// rgya: dpyid gsum thos pa'i man ngag btsal// dbyar gsum dben gnas dag tu bsgom// ston gsum gnas skor tshogs gnyis bsags// dgun gsum dben par rtse gcig bsgom// 'di dag dang po'i las can gyis// rtag tu don dam mtshan brjod 'don// spyod lam bden bzhi'i rnam pa can// 'jam dpal snyan rgyud gsang ba'i bka'// skal ldan gdul bya'i dpal du shog /sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa dus ji tsam na grol ba ni/

gter gzhung nas/ de ltar lam gyi man ngag ni// rnal 'byor srang du gzhug byas pas// mun la snang byung ji bzhin du// 'gyur ba gser 'gyur sman gyi tshul// gang gi glang chen myos 'dra'i sems// mnyam par bzhag pas brtul nas su// sngags dang phyag rgya rab brten na// dngos grub ya mtshan chen por 'gyur// rgya: zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam// bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis// dbang bsgyur rigs kyi dam pa 'grub// de tshe bcu drug tshun chad kyis// sku lnga lhun gyis rdzogs pa ni// ye shes thig le de nyid las// ye shes thig le de nyid snang*// grol ba'i sa rnams ston pa'o// rgya: yang na legs par gsungs pa ni// zla gcig drug gam bcu gcig na// yon tan rtags kyi dngos grub ni| |nges par thob kyi gzhan du min// rab 'bring tha ma'i blo can gyis// mthun par gsang bsgrags gzhan du min// brtson 'grus mchog gi skad cig gis// 'khor dang myang 'das bye brag 'byed| |mngon sum mthong na rdzogs sangs rgyas// rgya: 'bring ni zla gcig dag na grol// tha ma zla ba drug gis so// rgya: 'bring ni zla ba drug dang ni// bcu gnyis dag gam drug la'o| |rgya: tha ma lo gcig drug dang ni// bcu gnyis dag gis byang chub 'thob// grol ba thar pa rnam grol lus// rnam grol zhi ba zhi ba nyid// 'jam dpal rgyud don man ngag gis// legs par phye nas snga rabs kyi// rnam grol rnams kyi don du bshad// 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'dzin rgyal dang*// dga' rab rdo rje mañdzu shrī// pad+ma 'byung gnas rim pa'i bka'// phyi rabs las can don du bkod// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa lam 'di dus bab kyi gdams pa yin zhing zab par gdams pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ de ltar 'jam dpal don gyi yang tig gi// man ngag yang tig ces pa'i sgron me 'di// phyi rabs dus kyi sngags btsun gsang sngags la// khrom glu len zhing rgyud sde zong du 'tshong*// rang che 'byin zhing zab dgu gser dang brje// dam tshig mi bsrung tshe 'di'i 'dun gros sgrub// snyan grags lhur len phyi ma rgyang du sring*// skyabs 'gro spangs nas sha khrag hab thob za// bil lug sbril zhing dbang med gsang sngags sgrog

/dug lnga'i khyim du chos pa'i ming zhugs nas// sde snod gsum pa smod cing khyad du gsod// gsang sngags mtha' drug ming tsam bsgrang mi tsam// sa rtags 'gyur zhing gza' dang skar ma 'khrug /char chu sgang gshong lo phyugs sad ser 'joms// dge slong dmag byed mkhas btsun sa mthar 'khyam// mtha' dmag yul 'chol sdug bsngal khrag mtsho rdol// de 'dra'i dus ngan bstan pa'i mtha' la 'byung*| |de dus o rgyan bdag gi snying tig rnams// gter nas 'byung zhing yang tig chos kyi mdzod// khams gsum 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru// nam zhig dus kyi yang mthar gyur pa na// nga yi byin rlabs sku gsung thugs kyi mdzod// gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje yi// sprul pa 'byung gi de yis gsang ba'i don// legs par bkral nas gdul bya'i don byed 'gyur// de phyir lus dang bsam pa sbyor ba'i thabs// bskyed rdzogs snying po don gyi yang tig 'di// snying sgrom smug por sbas so sa ma ya: /dus la bab tshe 'gro ba'i don du shog /rig 'dzin rnam bzhi 'grub par gdon mi za/ kha thaṃ/ rgya rgya rgya : rab tu gsang ngo*// 'khor 'das kyi gshin rje rnams dang sngags kyi srung ma la gtad do// sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: so phag shi kha thaṃ/ gu h+ya/ zhes gsungs 'dug go// 'di ni bsam yas zhes bya ba'i dbu rtse'i steng khang gi// rnam snang bzhi sgrom gyi dbus kyi snying mdzod nas// mnga' ris glo bo paṇa chen pad+ma dbang gi rgyal po// ye shes rtsal gyis zab gter nyid du bzhes// gter gzhung dngos 'dir 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi// lung dang sbyar zhing shin tu go dka' ba| |kho nar mchis pa rnams 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung las son pa// dus mtha'i sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pa zhes bya ba yis// gter gzhung gi don la rang bzo dang bcos lhad 'khrul pa til 'bru tsam yang*// med par tshig sna bsdus shing go dka'i ba'i tshigs bcad rnams// go sla zhing nyams len 'khyer bde tshig lhug pa 'di yang*// nyi ma'i chu lug lo yi sa ga'i phyogs snga ma'i|

|rdzogs pa gnyis par pho brang rtse bar bris/ /'di ni sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud chen dang*// 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi dbu nas zhabs kyi bar sngags kyi nyams len ltar// bkral ba'i don lam bzang po yid ches khungs btsun zhing*// gsang chen snga 'gyur phyi 'gyur thams cad kyi// rim gnyis kyi gnad kun ma tshang med par sems// khyad par 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon la mos pa'i// skal ldan thar pa thob 'dod pa yod srid na// de rnams bsam sbyor ngan pas ngan sngags yig sna re re tsam shes pa la// nga ni gshin rje mkhan po yin no lo'i mkhas 'dod/ bdag 'dzin dug gi sdong po de spongs la// rgyal kun 'dus pa pad ma 'byung gnas rnga yab gling pa des// legs par gdams pa'i lam 'di nyams longs kwe// des ni mthar thug don gnyis 'grub pa la// zla drug la sogs dus gnad nges par bsrung na// gnas skabs phrin las rnam bzhi gang sgrub kyang*// thogs pa med par 'grub la som nyi ci phyir mchis// de ltar nyams len la 'bad pa dang bdag gis 'di bsgrigs pa'i rnam dkar gang mchis pas// 'gro kun 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' che'i// go 'phang thob la bdag yid lan gcig min par brgyar smon lam 'debs so// bdag kyang deng nas bzung ste 'jam mgon ma thob bar de srid du// rnam dag lam bzang 'di dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs// mi 'bral bar gtan gyi skyabs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kho na dang gcig nyams len lam 'di nyid gcig pu kho nar ma gtogs gzhan mi 'tshol ba// dam bca' snying gi thig ler dam bca' mthar phyin pa legs smin nas// zil gnon ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang dam pa der phyin nas// 'gro ba kun kyang de la 'god par gyur cig

/lam 'dir lhag pa'i lha 'di la skyabs gcig pur 'dzin pa/ slob dpon la dad cing snod ldan dag gis smin lam bdud dpung zil gnon dang*/ thun mong gi rdzogs rim dbang bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyis rgyud ma sbyang ba'i skye bo la sbyin na/ dpon slob de gnyis ka'i snying khrag las kyi gshin rje dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas bzhes shig /rol cig /bka'i chad pa chod cig /sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: slar gter gzhung dang zhib tu bstun pas tshig sne bstungs pa tsam ma gtogs don dang go rim dmigs pa la chad lhag spu tsam yang mi 'dug pas yang dag par sems so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
